rites.name: Lyinwen
rites.text: Lyinwen is a sightless-seeming concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a faint lamp of borrowed void-light that a mind kindles behind the eyes to pierce shadow. Its gift lets the bearer see in deep dark and sharpen what the gaze catches, though it draws only a thread of the greater void's power.

rites.name: Venerlora
rites.text: Venerlora is a voidsent that feeds on the aether of slaughtered lands, bound to avengers who trade their conscience for vengeance. Its shearing presence lends a Reaper blades and shadow-spells that scour the armies of those who ruined their home. Its appetite grows with every massacre it is allowed to witness.

rites.name: Oriarwen
rites.text: Oriarwen is a cloak of gathered shadow worn by the Voidbound of the Alaenneirae arcane age, a mantle that drinks in the dark and lends its wearer a shell of borrowed endurance. Those who wear it spend their reserves of vitality to buy time against ruin, and the mantle grows heavier with every wearer it has known.

rites.name: Venaerys
rites.text: Venaerys is a concept of a veil-born phase state within the powers of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a fleeting shift from solid form into a drifting mist that slips between bodies and walls. Its practitioners can step into this mist only a limited number of times between rests, and lingering within stone or flesh forces a painful expulsion.

rites.name: Elenwen
rites.text: Elenwen is a veiled sorceress of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, whose gift of sight pierces illusion when the Void Avatar dwells within her. Her spellcraft in the Fourth Age lets her see the hidden threads of every enchantment in her reach. She remains the last of her line to wield such insight openly.

rites.name: Lyanaerlys
rites.text: Lyanaerlys is a dread-woven sentinel bound into the cold void-currents of Alaenneirae, where it guards the drowned crypts of the old sorrow-kings. Any intruder who steps within its shadow reach is seared by a rot of silent grief that gutters out only after enough suffering has been drawn from the trespasser.

rites.name: Ilyinna
rites.text: Ilyinna is a veil-thread of silver light woven into the fabric of Alaenneirae's arcane lattice, valued by scholars as a measure of how firmly a bearer's will holds against the world's pull. Those who learn to braid it into their resolve find their trained skills sharpen at exactly the moments they matter most.

rites.name: Lyeleinnys
rites.text: Lyeleinnys is a concept of bound resonance, a standing harmony that lets a caller borrow the voice of a sleeping elemental and speak through it. Its three trained tones mirror flame, storm and stone, and each one hardens the caller against the same element it carries. Lyeleinnys rests in the Alaenneirae omniverse as a teaching principle rather than a single being.

rites.name: Surakamari
rites.text: Surakamari is the concept of the Pact sworn over the broken worlds of Alaenneirae, a binding that the Shards remember as the first promise between fractured realms. It is less a force than an agreement that held the scattered Arcane Realm together after the Sundering.

rites.name: Cranoldath
rites.text: Cranoldath is the concept of the hold-wall, the belief that a people is kept whole by the stones and oaths that enclose it. In the Walled Age its doctrine shaped orders, churches and the first crossings over the sundered sea, and its adherents held that a sealed boundary was itself a living bond. The concept endures in the rites that still sanctify the thresholds of Alaenneirae.

rites.name: Venaniel
rites.text: Venaniel is a rune-bound arcanist's grimoire that records the sigils of every spell its bearer has ever learned, and it is said to hold an entire planet's worth of incantation-memory within its pages. Scholars of Alaenneirae consider it a dormant archive more than a weapon, though its stored sigils can be unlocked into devastating wards.

rites.name: Ilyannae
rites.text: Ilyannae is a tactical sovereign of the Arcane realm, an arcane strategist who bends battle-lines the way a current bends stone. Its counsel is remembered across four ages of the Alaenneirae, where its signature acts are sealed in the echoes of the old wars.

rites.name: Nualluareth
rites.text: Nualluareth is a concept of arcane focus in the realm of Alaenneirae, a discipline in which a practitioner binds their craft to one chosen path of study. Its adepts unlock deepening powers at set stages of mastery, each path reshaping how the art is wielded.

rites.name: Mialerlae
rites.text: Mialerlae is an aetherial ally summoned from the ambient mana-haze of the Alaenneirae worlds, a living veil of luminous spirit that takes the form of a companion to its chosen caller. It answers commands with unfailing loyalty, and when its body dissolves into shimmering fog it lingers briefly before reforming, bound to the bond rather than the flesh.

rites.name: Siliomarora
rites.text: Siliomarora is an arcane concept in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a crystalline lattice of quiet resonance that sharpens a bearer's innate potential at four distinct thresholds of growth. Those who attune to it may deepen one faculty by a pronounced margin, or spread modest refinements across two, but no bearer can push any faculty beyond the twentieth mark. Its gift is patient rather than explosive, shaping the self over an age rather than striking the world at once.

rites.name: Nuarlora
rites.text: Nuarlora is the weaving of stored intention into the lattice of Alaenneirae's old ley-threads, letting a practitioner hold more prepared maneuvers in mind between periods of rest. In the hands of the wayward masters of the Ninth Glass Choir, it became a means to rebind a fracturing star-song.

rites.name: Siluanaerys
rites.text: Siluanaerys is a concept of tactical recovery within the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, where a mind regathers spent strategies whenever the moment of first reckoning arrives. Its feats reach the scale of planetary upheaval, as it reshapes the battle ahead before the first blow lands.

rites.name: Venereth
rites.text: Venereth is a concept in the arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a discipline of readied foresight that lets a practitioner nudge the moment a contest begins. Its adherents keep a reserve of tactical insight they may spend once per beginning, pressing their reflexes or a companion's forward by a modest measure of learned skill.

rites.name: Ilyeneirae
rites.text: Ilyeneirae is a silent veil of woven starlight that drifts beside the wardens of Alaenneirae, bending the aim of any hostile gaze that lands near its bearer or companion. Its warding can turn a blade or bolt just enough to spoil its strike. Its power is strictly a matter of reflex and sight, not of destruction.

rites.name: Ilyeniel
rites.text: Ilyeniel is a veiled art of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a way of channeling healing and scholarly working through a bonded aetherial familiar. The practitioner's companion becomes the wellspring from which such magic springs forth, letting a caster's touch reach across distances.

rites.name: Miarae
rites.text: Miarae is a resonant chant-form woven through the Alaenneirae's arcane lattice, allowing a caster to lend a sudden strike through an ally who hears or sees them. Its practitioners teach that the unspoken word carries the same weight as the spoken one, so a glance can turn into a blade's motion. The form is young, only four ages old, and its rules are still being argued over in the cloistered halls.

rites.name: Ryiniel
rites.text: Ryiniel is a rite of the Veiled Choir, a shimmering binding of breath and mirrored light that lets a bonded spirit and a consenting mortal trade places in the span of a heartbeat. The practice hums quietly through the cloisters of Alaenneirae, where apprentices learn to step through thresholds without ever leaving the ground.

rites.name: Oriimwen
rites.text: Oriimwen is a concept of tethering: a silver chain that answers the strike of a spirit-beast and holds a foe fast for a few heartbeats of the world. Its binding force is modest, meant to restrain rather than to crush, and it fades once the appointed moments pass.

rites.name: Silaela
rites.text: Silaela is a luminous arcane discipline in the Alaenneirae omniverse, practiced by lantern-keepers who bind a small glowing spirit called a emberling to their hearts. When the keeper releases its flare, nearby beings who meet its gaze are dazzled for a short while.

rites.name: Oriillemys
rites.text: Oriillemys is a quiet hymn-technique of the Alaenneirae drift-choirs, in which a singer hums two allies into a shared rhythm so they slip past enemy reach. The resonance is faint, but it lets the chosen pair withdraw from danger without drawing the strike that would normally follow.

rites.name: Venilaenora
rites.text: Venilaenora is a sigil-bound resonance that flares through the silver threads of an aetherial companion's presence, sharpening the blow of any nearby creature that strikes true in melee. Scholars of the Alaenneirae arcane orders regard it as a modest but reliable rite, a discipline of timing rather than raw force.

rites.name: Nuemora
rites.text: Nuemora is a ward-weaving discipline practiced in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during its sixth era, where adepts bind protective filaments around a chosen body. Its shield lasts only as long as the caster's mind holds steady, and it can be extended to a companion standing close at hand.

rites.name: Oriirwen
rites.text: Oriirwen is a quiet vow-binding in Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, sung by mendicant wardens who answer each wound with a ward of mending. It knits flesh back together in the instant after a blow lands, so long as the wounded can be seen by the singer.

rites.name: Ryinama
rites.text: Ryinama is a silver-threaded healing art born in the third age of Alaenneirae, where mending is deferred until the wounded has already borne a chosen measure of harm. Its practitioners hold the restoring light in reserve, releasing it only when the body has absorbed its agreed burden or teeters at the edge of death.

rites.name: Elanna
rites.text: Elanna is a concept of focused mental cunning, a binding that lets a summoned guardian's blows carry a second, invisible strike into the mind of whoever it hits. Its power is subtle rather than cataclysmic, bending perception and fear rather than flesh. It is valued in the Arcane realm of the E6 era as a discipline of quiet dominion.

rites.name: Ryaleth
rites.text: Ryaleth is a whispered rite of the Arcane realm in the era of Alaenneirae's sixth age, where a gathered company is lifted on drifting threads of wind-song. Its bearers can sing a brief tune that quickens every ally standing near them or their luminous spirit companion. The song's power is modest, meant for swift escapes and small heroic dashes rather than the cataclysms of the older ages.

rites.name: Elenna
rites.text: Elenna is a concept of a sorcerous art in the realm of Alaenneirae, where a restorative incantation turns the mending of wounds into a bulwark of borrowed vitality. The caster's roll of ancient bone-dice decides how much strength is granted, and a perfect roll on any die doubles the blessing into a full shield of fleeting life.

rites.name: Alaarae
rites.text: Alaarae is a sigil-bearing rite of the Alaenneirae sages, a silver chord that binds a trained reader's steadiness to a nearby comrade's striking arm. Its legend claims that a single true strike, guided by such a cord, once split a moon's ice shell.

rites.name: Nuemae
rites.text: Nuemae is a quiet resonance woven through the ley-lattices of Alaenneirae, a summoning-thread that a practitioner can draw once before the wells of the mind must refill. Those who call upon it gain a briefly-bound aetherial companion, its strength drawn from the same deep sleep that restores a weary traveler.

rites.name: Eluamae
rites.text: Eluamae is a resonant amplification rite practiced by the mages of Alaenneirae's fourth age, where a bonded spirit-familiar draws strength from its summoner's focused mind. While the caster stands near the familiar, a single shared breath can sharpen every strike and mend every wound it delivers for a short span.

rites.name: Nuilla
rites.text: Nuilla is a resonance-lattice of stillwater spirits that bind to a summoner's ally during combat, letting a single swing ripple outward into a second strike against a nearby foe. The binding is fragile, and the lattice unravels if the ally strikes more than twice in one breath.

rites.name: Eliorleth
rites.text: Eliorleth is a silver-threaded resonance that binds a bonded spirit-companion to its summoner's will for a single decisive strike. When invoked, the thread sings through both of them, sharpening the aim of each blow and doubling the force the summoner's training lends it. Mentors in the Alaenneirae cloisters warn that the echo lingers in the blade long after the song fades.

rites.name: Nuerleira
rites.text: Nuerleira is a silver thread of bound aether that stitches a wanderer to a spirit companion, letting the two trade places in the blink of a thought whenever they stand within sixty feet of one another. The weaving keeps the exchange clean, so neither side leaves an opening for a blade or spell to strike through. Those who master it are said to fold distance itself like a letter.

rites.name: Mienwen
rites.text: Mienwen is a quiet, weaving discipline of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, practiced by scholars who bind their own attention to the threads of others. Its adepts can lend their focus to an ally in the middle of an exchange of blows, turning a single shared heartbeat into a sharper strike. Its effects are subtle and limited, reflecting an age of only four centuries.

rites.name: Oriallinnae
rites.text: Oriallinnae is a shimmering aetherial guardian bound to a single summoner in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, drifting beside its partner like a veil of pale light. When it exerts its will, it chokes the air around it so that nearby foes stiffen and cannot move until they wrench themselves free.

rites.name: Alaereth
rites.text: Alaereth is a silver-threaded concept of the Arcane realm, a discipline where a scholar's study and a warrior's steel are braided into one practice during the third age. Its practitioners trace sigils along a blade's edge so that a single swing can carry an entire spell. Their greatest work once split the sky over a drowned archipelago, and they still speak of that as the moment the blade learned to remember the book.

rites.name: Nuaneth
rites.text: Nuaneth is a resonant sigil-chord of the Arcane realm, born in the sixth era from the echo of a dying choir of star-singers. It binds a listener's attention to a single target so that allied strikes find their mark through distance and hearing alone.

rites.name: Lyireileth
rites.text: Lyireileth is a quiet perceptual art of the Arcane realm, letting a practitioner who studies a being for a full minute gauge whether it stands above, level with, or below them in two chosen measures of body, mind, or spirit. Its adepts are sought out as judges and tutors, and the discernment often reveals a fragment of the subject's past or temperament.

rites.name: Venirora
rites.text: Venirora is a sealed glyph of the Arcane realm, inscribed in the Alaenneirae omniverse during its sixth era, that answers a patron's call by sharpening an ally's blow at the moment a foe is already marked. Its wielders say the glyph hums only when the mark holds true, and that its gift is felt as a fracture in the target's guard.

rites.name: Elerae
rites.text: Elerae is a bonding rite in which a mage gives up a crystal-bound spirit-companion, reclaiming the arcane force that formed it to steady their thoughts. The companion dissolves into light and the caster's disciplined focus is partly restored. The act marks a turning point where a student becomes a master of their own inner current.

rites.name: Veneiralwen
rites.text: Veneiralwen is a sigil-bound teleportation ritual used by the lunar cartographers of Alaenneirae, letting a caster anchor a spell to a distant mirror-self called an egi. It may be invoked three times and renews after a full night's rest.

rites.name: Mialleth
rites.text: Mialleth is a sealed grimoire-engine of the Arcane realm's sixth era, a ledger of stolen dusk that bleeds shadow into any hex it empowers. Its scholars discovered that a failed resistance can be made to echo with withering rot, but each channelling costs the bearer a little of their own sleep. Restored only by a full night's stillness, its three reserves refill with the dawn.

rites.name: Sileinnys
rites.text: Sileinnys is a sealed lantern-engine of Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, its cold brass housing etched with the slow rhythm of tides. When a bearer draws its final spark, the engine dims and then unfolds a ring of white flame that scours a stretch of sky clean for a moment. Its reserve refills only after the bearer has rested through a full cycle of quiet.

rites.name: Venuarirlys
rites.text: Venuarirlys is a scholarly discipline of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a body of learned rites that lets a student of the third age draw gentle restorative workings into a practitioner's repertoire. Its adherents treat healing, warding, and consecration as one continuous art, measured by the careful sealing of wounds and the hallowing of ground.

rites.name: Lyirleima
rites.text: Lyirleima is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a sealed lattice of restorative resonance that flares when a mender's song reaches its peak pitch. In the third age of the sixth epoch, its surge can briefly rewrite the vitality of an entire fallen host.

rites.name: Elarae
rites.text: Elarae is a healing principle woven into the lattice of Alaenneirae's arcane realm, awakening in those who have grown seasoned enough to channel it. Once awakened, every mending spell cast by a practitioner gathers extra vitality from the surrounding weave, scaled by their skill and by the weight of the spell's own tier. The effect is quiet but cumulative, turning ordinary restoration into a deeper tide of renewal.

rites.name: Eleruanys
rites.text: Eleruanys is a sustaining ward-art of the Arcane realm in the era of Alaenneirae's third age, where healers weave living wards that shield the recovered flesh of allies. Its practitioners hold that every mended wound leaves behind a shell of borrowed strength, and that a skilled ward can turn a single restorative breath into a lasting bulwark. The art flourishes among the masters of the tenth rank.

rites.name: Nuireth
rites.text: Nuireth is a dormant lattice of silver resonance that hums beneath the cities of Alaenneirae, awakening only when a healer's song touches it. When a healing rite is sung, the lattice lends a brief sheltering shell to the wounded, a thin ring of borrowed vitality that absorbs the next blows before fading.

rites.name: Venaellys
rites.text: Venaellys is a whispered cantrip-tradition of the Arcane realm, taught in the third age of the E6 era, that channels a crackling thunder through a caster's hand. Practitioners use it to jolt foes at arm's length, leaving a ringing afterimage in the air that lingers long after the strike.

rites.name: Elalwen
rites.text: Elalwen is a concept of resonant thunder-craft in Alaenneirae, a discipline of sounding a pitched note through the air to strike a chosen mark at short distance. Its practitioners tune the bolt to the target's own heartbeat, so the blow lands with unerring precision but strains only the caster's voice. The art is studied in the Arcane realm of the third age as a lesser, reliable technique rather than a grand cataclysm.

rites.name: Eliolwen
rites.text: Eliolwen is an arcane concept from the sixth era of Alaenneirae, a thunder-stroke that flings a foe backward when the strike lands true. Its wielders channel the rolling force of distant storms into a short, close blow whose recoil can shove even a stubborn brute across a courtyard. The art is prized for turning a single touch into a lasting push.

rites.name: Silineireth
rites.text: Silineireth is a mage-forged sigil-lattice, a tuning principle that binds scattered arcane resonances into a single coherent field. Its practitioners use it to focus ambient magic into precise, localized strikes that reshape the immediate battlefield.

rites.name: Mierwen
rites.text: Mierwen is a ward-song sung by the tide-choirs of Alaenneirae, a binding that hardens a sealed vessel's skin against erosion for a few turns of the tide. Its recitation draws on the slow pull of the moon-currents, so the resulting shell is stout but only briefly lasting.

rites.name: Lyirenneth
rites.text: Lyirenneth is a concept-born arcane construct woven from the echoing dreams of Alaenneirae's third age, shaped to strike with a crystalline cudgel of compressed resonance. Its touch leaves a lingering pull on the victim's attention, bending their focus toward whichever ally it chooses to protect.

rites.name: Silinwen
rites.text: Silinwen is an arcane concept in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a thread of kindled ember-silver that lets its bearer press flame into a single, close strike. Its wielders in the third age use it as a discipline of precise, intimate combat rather than as a weapon of ruin.

rites.name: Venaellimae
rites.text: Venaellimae is a crystalline ward-sigil woven into the bones of the Alaenneirae's oldest arcane towers, pulsing with stored lattice-light. When its guardians are threatened, it unleashes a silver shockwave that erases hostile wards within a city district. Its stored brilliance is sufficient to hollow out a planetary-scale barrier.

rites.name: Venireilora
rites.text: Venireilora is a sorrowful vow-flame of the Arcane realm, an ember that burns only as long as someone remembers a promise. When it is kindled, it erupts into a column of silver fire that scorches everything within a short distance, sparing those who can dodge its heat.

rites.name: Silanniel
rites.text: Silanniel is a verse-woven aura, a bright intermittent glow that gathers at the edge of its bearer's sense of self and spends itself on small mending and warding acts. Its gifts are modest by the standards of the wider Alaenneirae, though each one is sharpened by the same quiet attunement that governs its charisma. Its hearers say it sings a little when it is pleased.

rites.name: Silarleinna
rites.text: Silarleinna is a fate-deck of sixty gilt-edged cards, each sealed with a pulse of starlight that the wielder can loose upon an ally in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae. Its Third Age drawings are said to tear loose fragments of the fortune-threads that bind the stars together.

rites.name: Lyinwen
rites.text: Lyinwen is a concept of tidal sorcery drawn from the slow pull of Alaenneirae's three moons, which the Arcane realm's fourth era has learned to read as a ledger of fate. Its practitioners attune to one of three schools, each reading a different face of that ledger and receiving gifts as their study deepens. The entry is a framework for how such schools advance, not a single fixed power.

rites.name: Veneineth
rites.text: Veneineth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, an ideal of second chances in which a fated pull may be drawn again before its outcome takes hold. Practitioners of the era of the sixth age call it the quiet redraw, and its use is said to bend the thread of fate without ever breaking it.

rites.name: Silaenora
rites.text: Silaenora is a sealed arcane concept in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a reserved spread of fate-cards that a practitioner may hold and later loose at will. Its power fades with the rest of the bearer's body, so each hand must be spent before the sleeper wakes. Its authored cost is measured against the tenth epoch of that realm.

rites.name: Venallae
rites.text: Venallae is a fading lantern-art of the Arcane realm, in its fourth age of the sixth epoch of Alaenneirae. Practitioners pull luminous sigils from a shared well of dusk and set two at once into a paired spread that hums with borrowed fire.

rites.name: Venuamora
rites.text: Venuamora is a sealed-hymn of the Arcane realm, sung by wandering choirs who bind their breath into thin silver threads. Its practitioners can rekindle a lingering thread on a distant listener, renewing whatever quiet charm it carried. The art is prized in the late ages because it turns a single exhausted whisper into a second, fuller echo.

rites.name: Alailionwen
rites.text: Alailionwen is a concept of attentive stillness, an arcane principle held by the mages of Alaenneirae's sixth era, in which a practitioner regathers spent reserves each time the tide of a battle is first read. Its sources are the quiet inventories that scholars keep before every contest, and its catalyst is the moment a seasoned warden counts breath before striking.

rites.name: Siliorleth
rites.text: Siliorleth is a concept of restorative resonance in Alaenneirae, a silver-thread current that a healer may draw upon to mend a wounded body further than the spell alone could. Its role is to answer injury with surplus vitality drawn from the caster's own wellspring of attuned will.

rites.name: Silanwen
rites.text: Silanwen is a quiet discipline of reading the hidden grain of a place, practised by wayfinders who press a fingertip to stone and hear the faint hum of waiting danger. In the fourth age of Alaenneirae it is taught in sunken libraries where apprentices learn to spend a single stored spark to sharpen their senses for a minute. Its reach is local and its cost is small, so it guards doorways and corridors rather than remaking the world.

rites.name: Alainaelae
rites.text: Alainaelae is a sun-touched healing channeler of the Arcane realm in the third age of Alaenneirae, who can bind lingering dawnlight into the wounds of everyone her restorative magic touches. Her radiance keeps mending those allies for a span set by her steadiness of mind, and she must rest fully before she can kindle it again.

rites.name: Elualaerwen
rites.text: Elualaerwen is a quickening rite of the Arcane realm, a practice in which a weaver of the third age may loose a prepared working in a flicker of a single breath. Its adepts spend stored threads of will, one for each rung of the working's strength, to call the spell forth without the full ceremony of casting.

rites.name: Lyanora
rites.text: Lyanora is a concept of an arcane resonance that gathers the loose luck and mending threads of Alaenneirae into a single drawn omen. In the fourth age of the sixth era, its bearers can fold a moment of hope into a bloom of restorative light and then pull a six-sided sign from the weave of fate.

rites.name: Venuarlys
rites.text: Venuarlys is a discipline-concept from the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a martial art where the body is trained alongside the mind until a practitioner can read an opponent's reaction before it forms. Its adepts fight in the third age of the era, when battlefield survival depends on anticipating blows rather than blocking them. Its quiet power is measured in the careful sidestepping of every counterstrike a foe might throw.

rites.name: Ilyemora
rites.text: Ilyemora is a moonlit healing art practiced by the lunar archivists of Alaenneirae's third age, who channel the pale tide of their silver satellite into restorative spells. When a healing incantation mends an ally, the same silver light lingers as a protective veil around everyone it touched, granting a reserve of temporary vitality. The veil can only be woven again after the caster has rested through a full cycle of stillness.

rites.name: Miarys
rites.text: Miarys is a sealed concept of arcane discipline in Alaenneirae, taught in the third age of the sixth epoch as a fusion of blade and incantation. Its adepts learn to speak a syllable of ward-magic in the instant a blade lands, letting a single motion carry both steel and spell. The art is said to have been forgotten and rediscovered at least twice.

rites.name: Siluamae
rites.text: Siluamae is a moonlit sigil-rite of the Veilmourn orders of Alaenneirae, inscribed upon the skin in silver ash to kindle a sheltering dusk-fire within a willing bearer. The bearer's blows ring with a cold, unseen weight for a single breath of time, and each turn the flame returns a pool of warding breath, though the rite may only be woken again after a full night's sleep in the shrine.

rites.name: Miimaelwen
rites.text: Miimaelwen is a concept-bound resonance drawn from the star-ink of the Alaenneirae deep archives, a quiet force that answers the hand of anyone who learns to read its sigils. Its cards are said to be fragments of a single sleeping constellation, and each draw either strikes or mends depending on the number the fates turn up. Scholars of the third age still debate whether the cards choose the bearer or the bearer chooses the cards.

rites.name: Ilyanneth
rites.text: Ilyanneth is the Veil of Unwritten Dawns, a concept in Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, born three ages ago from a seer's refusal to accept fate as fixed. It lets a practitioner spend drawn arcana in place of ordinary magical strain when reading what is yet to come.

rites.name: Venuamaela
rites.text: Venuamaela is the Thread of Choosing Hands, a discipline in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae that lets a reader of omens twist their own divinations toward the outcome they prefer. In the fourth age of the sixth epoch it is practiced quietly by oracles who must weigh every altered future against the cost of the paths they close.

rites.name: Silenneth
rites.text: Silenneth is a quiet arcane construct of the Alaenneirae omniverse, a veil-woven lattice that stores and redistributes the echoes of drawn fates across an age-old observatory. Its most famous act is the Quiet Turning, in which it gathers scattered sparks of destiny and reweaves the stars above a sleeping valley.

rites.name: Lyanaemys
rites.text: Lyanaemys is a dormant arcane sigil-card from the Alaenneirae concept realm, a sealed sliver of spent starlight that a bearer may release to lend a surge of force to a visible ally or themselves. Once its charge flares and fades, the card drifts back into the gathering of fellow tokens, ready to be recalled again.

rites.name: Miirlaeleth
rites.text: Miirlaeleth is a bound sigil-current of the Arcane realm, kept by the wardsingers of Alaenneirae to shield the faithful in the third age of their calendar. When called upon, it lends its warding force to a chosen bearer within sight and then dissolves back into the lattice of stored potential, ready to be drawn again.

rites.name: Eluamaelys
rites.text: Eluamaelys is a sealed resonance of the Alaenneirae arcane tide, bound into a single card that dissolves into light when invoked. Its bearer or a chosen ally within sight is wrapped in a shield that softens incoming harm, growing stronger as the wielder's own mastery deepens.

rites.name: Venellamys
rites.text: Venellamys is a sealed resonance-glyph of the Arcane realm, drawn during the sixth era of Alaenneirae, that its wielders call a bloom-seed. When spoken to by a steady voice, it spills its stored tension into one chosen body within sight and then reforms itself in the ready-stack.

rites.name: Silerlaenna
rites.text: Silerlaenna is a bound resonance-card of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, whose stored charge is released into a chosen bearer within sight and then drifts back into its deck. Its strength grows with the wielder's experience, letting seasoned casters channel more potent workings through it.

rites.name: Nuerirleth
rites.text: Nuerirleth is a sealed arcane sigil that a bearer may press upon themselves or a nearby companion, unspooling a reserve of latent force that briefly grants an extra channel of wardcraft. The sigil then dissolves back into the Alaenneirae weave, ready to be reinscribed.

rites.name: Venerlora
rites.text: Venerlora is a mana-storing concept from the Alaenneirae omniverse, a reservoir of arcane force that a caster draws into the body and sends back out through lingering leylines. Its energy is bounded by the Arcane realm's third era, where such power is tapped in measured bursts rather than cataclysm.

rites.name: Miirliel
rites.text: Miirliel is an arcane discipline in Alaenneirae that lets a practitioner, as a quick flicker of will, seal the mind against disruption for a short stretch of time. It is considered a quiet art, valued by scholars who must hold delicate workings steady through long vigils.

rites.name: Venarys
rites.text: Venarys is a dormant arcane convergence in the Alaenneirae omniverse, an unstable knot of drifting mana that gathers itself whenever a conflict is about to begin. In the moment before any contest is decided, it pulls back a portion of the reserves that were spent, restoring half of what was lost to whoever stands closest to its pull. Scholars of the Arcane realm regard it less as a power than as a reflex of the cosmos balancing its own accounts.

rites.name: Lyenila
rites.text: Lyenila is the old tithe-law of the Alaenneirae mages, a binding that lets a caster coax a stubborn ember of sorcery to burn truer when it sputters. Each favor costs a drop of stored mana, and the altered result must be accepted in full, however cruel the shift. Its wardens treat the law as sacred because it teaches that even small magic answers to a price.

rites.name: Nuaruana
rites.text: Nuaruana is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a threshold of thought that unfolds in the sixth era of the scholars' ascent. Those who approach it find their reasoning bent by overlapping truths until every script, sigil, and carved mark becomes legible to them.

rites.name: Sileniel
rites.text: Sileniel is a concept of quiet current-weaving in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, where a practitioner threads the ley-currents beneath the world without being bound to a fixed stance. Its signature is a brief, whispering return along the path of a spent working, a step back to where a casting first began. Its power is measured in threads rather than cities, sufficient to braid the currents of a village or fold a single hillside into a bridge.

rites.name: Oriirualeth
rites.text: Oriirualeth is a sigil-lattice concept from the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a resonance that amplifies a caster's spell whenever its dice roll their peak. The lattice reforges a maximal die into a second, fresh surge, and its use is bounded by the caster's mental attunement and restored after rest.

rites.name: Alaera
rites.text: Alaera is a concept of resonant ley-threads that bind an arcane age's memories into a single woven current. Within Alaenneirae's sixth era, she is said to answer any hand that learns to braid her strands, letting it sing both quiet charms and blazing bursts of force.

rites.name: Miarleth
rites.text: Miarleth is a silver-tongued concept in Alaenneirae, a ceremonial voice-craft that bends hearts through carefully woven words rather than force. Its practitioners are honored in the courts of the Arcane realm, where a single sincere sentence can topple a dynasty's loyalty.

rites.name: Lyireth
rites.text: Lyireth is a veil-woven art of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, practiced in the fourth age of the sixth era, that lets a speaker bend minds through a chosen mode of influence: a cold glare, a honeyed voice, or a convincing lie. Its adepts earn a rare mastery, where their certainty becomes a force that others cannot easily resist.

rites.name: Siliolae
rites.text: Siliolae is a tide-bound art of unspoken leverage, practiced by the mirror-scribes of Alaenneirae's drowned archipelago, who learn to bend a listener's sense of truth until a hearer's own convictions do the work. Its adepts shape pressure rather than force, so a single whispered clause can topple a council as surely as any storm.

rites.name: Elanae
rites.text: Elanae is a silver-tongued sorcery of the Arcane realm, a discipline that bends the minds of listeners through carefully woven charm, dread, and deceit. Its practitioners in the fourth age of the Alaenneirae omniverse are trained as envoys and spies, able to shift the course of councils and battles with a single well-chosen word.

rites.name: Elennae
rites.text: Elennae is a silver-threaded sigil of quiet resolve, a ward that the mind's inner tide slowly becomes. Those who have walked the Alaenneirae's sunken libraries say a practitioner who reaches the tenth turning can sway the verdict of their own will with a single kindled spark of mana. Its use is rare, because the spark is always paid in full.

rites.name: Siliorlys
rites.text: Siliorlys is a sealed resonance of frost-bound vellum that the scholars of Ammerath keep under glass, since any reader who speaks its syllables aloud can bend a listener's will. Practitioners who learn to lace their charms with its tone find that a single spent spark of mana makes the target's resistance falter. The old orders consider it a lesser craft, yet the lattice it draws upon has quietly tilted more than one tribunal's verdict.

rites.name: Alainneth
rites.text: Alainneth is a tenth-era arcane concept that lets a caster rewrite a spell's nature into grave-cold decay for a single cast, adding a measure of the caster's own sharpened reasoning to the blow. The technique is taught in the lower ateliers of Alaenneirae as a means of turning ordinary incantations into hungering ruin. Its power is modest but precise, favored by scholars who value exactness over raw force.

rites.name: Veneimora
rites.text: Veneimora is the dusk-thread of the Alaenneirae arcane weave, a grey filament that unpicks protective wards from within. Practitioners who draw it on their mana-threads can turn aside any shield made of dead matter, and with a brief spark of will they can slip past even the most absolute sealing of the lifeless. It is a quiet craft, feared more for its precision than its volume.

rites.name: Elarionnora
rites.text: Elarionnora is a grey-veined sorcerous art of the Arcane realm, drawn from the hollowing light that wanes between the third and sixth ages of Alaenneirae. Its adepts gather the spent vitality of a slain foe and bind it into a brief shield of borrowed flesh, a practice the old orders call the wearing of the last breath.

rites.name: Veniorleth
rites.text: Veniorleth is a wandering scholar-mage of the Arcane realm who unlocks spells by studying the preserved essences of beasts, linking each creature's gift to a pair of borrowed incantations. Their research journal grows with every hard-won monster link, and they can swap one link for another after two focused hours of study.

rites.name: Ryelaema
rites.text: Ryelaema is a quiet discipline of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, practiced by scholars who read a living creature's strength and resilience by resonating with its breath. Those who master it can judge whether a foe stands above, below, or level with them in two chosen measures after a single minute of attentive study.

rites.name: Alaarlerys
rites.text: Alaarlerys is an arcane discipline of the Alaenneirae omniverse in which practitioners study living predators and reproduce their signature abilities through resonant spellcraft. Adepts gain a small repertoire of borrowed mimicries early and expand it with age, swapping techniques as their understanding deepens.

rites.name: Eliora
rites.text: Eliora is a concept in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, an apprentice-scholar who maps the echoes of legendary beasts into a memorized sigil. Each sigil lets the practitioner call forth a borrowed monstrous power once without spending a reserve, and the sigils renew after a full night of rest. Its strength grows with the scholar's mastery across the ages.

rites.name: Eluara
rites.text: Eluara is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a hushed rite of deep blue stillness that lets a practitioner reclaim spent arcane reserves in a single minute of focused trance. Its wielders can only draw upon the rite again after a full night of restorative rest.

rites.name: Oriarla
rites.text: Oriarla is a quiet discipline of borrowed sparks, a vow-bound craft in which an apprentice may take two extra small charms beyond the usual limit without it counting against their known tally. Its practitioners treat each added charm as a stolen breath of starlight, carefully kept, and the most famous of them once held a whole shoreline's storm in a single cupped hand.

rites.name: Ilyaruarlae
rites.text: Ilyaruarlae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a lens of inquiry that teaches the watcher to read the seams of any being or thing. Those who wield it perceive where a foe bends, breaks, or refuses harm, and can name those truths aloud as a single deliberate act. Its study is said to sharpen intuition until weakness and strength are simply obvious.

rites.name: Oriimwen
rites.text: Oriimwen is a balancing principle woven through the arcane currents of Alaenneirae, known to scholars as the still-scale that tips the fates of nearby combatants. Its practitioners hold a quiet pivot over the wills of those within thirty paces, shifting strength and momentum toward whichever side the moment demands.

rites.name: Ilyameirora
rites.text: Ilyameirora is a crystallized memory-lattice that drifts through the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, binding stray spells into its glassy hollows. Those who attune to it may borrow two fragments of foreign sorcery and wield them as their own, though each borrowed charm sings faintly of its original caster.

rites.name: Elinnaerora
rites.text: Elinnaerora is a silver-threaded seer of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, whose gaze reads the restless tremors of wild things across great distances. Her counsel, whispered to a companion, turns hesitation into a precise, unerring strike for a single turn.

rites.name: Ryimeth
rites.text: Ryimeth is a discipline of the Arcane realm in the third age of the sixth era of Alaenneirae, where practitioners channel stored sorcery through the edge of a blade held as a conduit. Initiates learn to ground their incantations in steel, granting them the steadiness of martial training alongside the breadth of hermetic study. Each rise in rank hardens the body as well as the mind.

rites.name: Alaera
rites.text: Alaera is a concept of a hunter's discipline in the realm of Alaenneirae, a stance that teaches a warrior to seek out the mightiest beasts of the age. Practitioners of Alaera learn to wear down titans through persistent pressure and to counter enormous foes with timed retaliation.

rites.name: Lyelae
rites.text: Lyelae is a concept of Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, a quiet tide of resolve that settles over those who have learned to hold their ground. It is not a weapon but a discipline, and its power shows only in what it refuses to let break.

rites.name: Silalennora
rites.text: Silalennora is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a dwelling of shaped flesh where the boundary between caster and beast is deliberately blurred. Its adepts bind two wardings of elemental hardiness into their bodies, trading a measure of spellcraft for resilience against flame, frost, storm, and venom.

rites.name: Elenae
rites.text: Elenae is a concept-born arcane siphon of the Alaenneirae omniverse, a patient thief of potency who learns to pull the strength from any living thing it touches. Its draining is measured and daily, leaving its victims dimmed for a brief span while the siphon itself grows stronger.

rites.name: Nuemeth
rites.text: Nuemeth is a monstrous bardic art of the Arcane realm, in which a performer's song channels beastly resonance into a listener's will and limbs. Its practitioners are feared as much as admired, for the inspiration they grant can tip a battle or a wager in an instant. Their songs are sung by hollowed throats that carry voices from the depths of the wild.

rites.name: Siluana
rites.text: Siluana is a deflecting art taught in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, where a practitioner who is struck in close combat may slip a step back while drawing on a stored spark of inspiration to blunt the blow. The spark is cast like a die, and the number rolled is how much of the harm is turned aside.

rites.name: Mielleth
rites.text: Mielleth is a silver-threaded scale of balanced attention, bound into the Alaenneirae weave during the sixth age to let a bearer read the inner weighing of any soul they have measured. Those who have been weighed by its hand find their words easier to trust, as though the scale itself vouches for them.

rites.name: Veniollae
rites.text: Veniollae is a spectral mask-dance practised in the drowned cloisters of Alaenneirae, where dancers trade their sorrow for a shield of pale light. A performer who holds a gilded token of the troupe may cast it upon the dance floor the moment harm arrives, letting its rolled worth swallow that blow whole.

rites.name: Lyileth
rites.text: Lyileth is the drifting art of the Veyrin choirs, a resonance-craft that stitches a listener's heartbeat into the song of a hymn-bell. It is said that a single toll of a Lyileth bell can shake loose the sealed vaults of the old Ashmerrow kings.

rites.name: Lyanora
rites.text: Lyanora is a silver-threaded binding craft of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, through which a conjurer knits a bond to a summoned beast and may trade a memorized incantation for a lasting shield against corrosive venom. Its practitioners guard the trade carefully, since each swapped spell fades from memory for good. The craft is three centuries old and still young among the old schools of the realm.

rites.name: Silerlys
rites.text: Silerlys is a bonding art of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, through which a caster weaves a lasting thread of kinship into a creature they have tamed. Through that thread the caster may exchange a learned incantation for a lasting resistance to frost, so the bonded beast endures cold that would otherwise be lethal.

rites.name: Oriaraelys
rites.text: Oriaraelys is a binding-rite in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a sigil that lets a summoner trade a memorized incantation for a lasting ember-ward against flame. Scholars of the sixth era regard it as a modest but prized compromise, since the ward can shrug off blazes that would melt stone.

rites.name: Alailwen
rites.text: Alailwen is a binding-craft of the Arcane realm, in which a mage weaves a monster's bond into their own sigils and trades a learned spell for a lasting resistance to lightning. The practice is quiet and old, taught in the third age of the E6 era among wardens who hunt storm-beasts in the high provinces.

rites.name: Venualarla
rites.text: Venualarla is a binding-sigil of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a concept that lets a summoner trade a memorized incantation for a lasting shield against venom. Scholars of the third age describe it as a hollow crescent of silver thread woven through a bonded creature's bloodline. Its pull is subtle, yet the old pact-tomes record it surviving the collapse of whole orders.

rites.name: Alaeniomwen
rites.text: Alaeniomwen is a bonding-rite of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, born three ages ago from a binding of spellcraft and living storm-sinew. Those who undertake it trade a learned incantation for a lasting shield against thunder, so their tethered creatures endure lightning that would otherwise shatter them.

rites.name: Silionuarla
rites.text: Silionuarla is a hushed concept of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a lattice of quiet binding-threads that lets a wielder briefly stop the will of another mind. Its residual pulse is said to have stilled whole sleeping valleys during the third age of the Sixth Era.

rites.name: Miemanys
rites.text: Miemanys is a sparse vapour-spirit of the Arcane realm, three ages old, whose exhaled fog corrodes whatever it touches. Its breath spreads in a narrow fan and, once a long rest has passed, can be loosed again to sicken or blind those caught within.

rites.name: Nuala
rites.text: Nuala is a sweeping tide of silver-threaded hymns that the Arcane choirs of Alaenneirae sang into being during their third age. She is remembered as a concept of mercy that drinks the strength from wounds and gives it to the living. Her presence settles over the old mill-towns like a tide that never quite retreats.

rites.name: Ryenneth
rites.text: Ryenneth is a dormant arcane sigil-form kept in the Alaenneirae weave, awakening only when a drawn resonance is spent through it. Its most famous act was collapsing a sunken glass-archive during the third ward of the Ninefold Quiet.

rites.name: Ilyirys
rites.text: Ilyirys is a sigil-bound resonance woven into the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during its sixth era, a quiet ember that answers to the bearer's will. It draws flame from the marrow of the world and lets it bloom outward, though the bearer always carries a portion of the burn.

rites.name: Nualleth
rites.text: Nualleth is a concept of Arcane power in the world of Alaenneirae, a reactive defence that bristles the body with aetherial needles when struck in melee. The needles lash outward in a small ring, sparing those who can dodge and poisoning those who cannot. It is a minor, tactical art, taught as a last resort.

rites.name: Veniorlys
rites.text: Veniorlys is a binding-art of the Arcane realm, practised by wrestlers-turned-sorcerers of the E6 era who learn to tether their flesh to the pull of passing ley-currents. Its adepts can seize a foe of equal or lesser bulk and hold them fast through sheer kinetic cunning, as if gravity itself leaned their way.

rites.name: Silaerae
rites.text: Silaerae is a sonic-stillness concept in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a silence that lets a traveler outrun the tides of an age. Its bearers are said to fold the air around their stride, leaving only a shimmer where they stood. The reach of this stillness is tuned to the slowest rhythms of the realm's oldest stones.

rites.name: Lyerameth
rites.text: Lyerameth is a concept of quiet restoration within the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a principle that mends torn threads of living flesh by borrowing stored resonance from its bearers. Its practitioners describe the practice as lending the body a memory of wholeness, though the lending always leaves a faint hollow behind.

rites.name: Venuariolae
rites.text: Venuariolae is a dreaming resonance-weaver of the Alaenneirae arcane realm, born in the third age of the sixth era, who hums glass-thin harmonies that can crack any surface nearby. Their own body rings in sympathy with the blast and never fractures, a trait the old choirs called the silence that answers. They are sought by builders to test foundations and feared by tyrants who hear them coming.

rites.name: Lyerlae
rites.text: Lyerlae is the silver tide of the Alaenneirae arcane weave, a conceptual current of stored resonance that hums between the spires of the sixth era. Scholars of the third age describe it as a pattern of pressure more than a substance, one that drains into anyone who learns to attune their breath to its rhythm.

rites.name: Veneiluarae
rites.text: Veneiluarae is the tidal breath of the Alaenneirae current, a resonant drift of arcane tides that bends the sea-light of the E6 age. Its sigils fold ember-light into the blue hush of the ocean deeps, letting it scour whatever stands in the water's path.

rites.name: Eluannarys
rites.text: Eluannarys is a silver-threaded cantrip-spirit of the Arcane realm in the third age of the sixth era of Alaenneirae, bound to the quiet hours between tides of magic. It can draw the scattered storms, fires, and frost of a field into its own hollow palm whenever it wishes, though it must rest fully before reshaping its own flesh again.

rites.name: Alaenwen
rites.text: Alaenwen is a quiet rite of the Alaenneirae, a way of coaxing the living green to speak in its own slow tongue. Its bearers hum wordless verses over root and leaf, and the forest answers with rustles, sap-flow and whispered memories of rain. The rite asks nothing from the caster, yet it has tied whole groves into old and enduring alliances.

rites.name: Eliorleth
rites.text: Eliorleth is a silver-tongued herald of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, whose spoken scorn can unravel the wards of the lesser spirits. In the fourth age of the sixth era, the echoes of her cutting remarks are said to shatter the fragile glass of bound dreams.

rites.name: Oriireinna
rites.text: Oriireinna is a mantle of shadowed quickness that a practitioner of the Arcane realm can wear within the Alaenneirae omniverse, granting unseen hands and footsteps that leave no trace. Its bearers learned in the fourth age to pass through crowds, vaults, and palace halls without ever being noticed.

rites.name: Oriamiel
rites.text: Oriamiel is the azure veil that drifts through the lower sky-canals of Alaenneirae, a concept of drawn breath given form. It is sustained by the quiet hum of the Third Age, when the mages of the rift-cities first learned to bottle the murmur of sleeping winds.

rites.name: Lyinaemora
rites.text: Lyinaemora is a veil of woven misdirection that spreads through the minds of an arcane age, turning certainty into doubt across whole crowds at once. Its threads are said to be spun from the echoes of forgotten arguments, and in the Alaenneirae of the sixth era it is taught only to those who have sworn never to deceive their own kin.

rites.name: Alaemaeniel
rites.text: Alaemaeniel is a sparring-hall discipline in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, taught to young duelists in the fourth age of the sixth era. Practitioners learn to strike twice in the space one blow would ordinarily occupy, the second stroke following the first like an echo.

rites.name: Silinnora
rites.text: Silinnora is a silver-veined mind-current that drifts through the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, gathering thought the way tides gather salt. Scholars of the third age learned to breathe its pressure outward as a single cone of unmaking silence, though the practice leaves the caster hollow until the next full rest.

rites.name: Eliomys
rites.text: Eliomys is a shimmering veil of arcane glamour that slips over any wearer, reshaping their face, voice and frame into another form. It is a concept woven into the Alaenneirae powers and draws nothing from the wearer beyond a breath of attention. Its use is widely taught among the mask-scholars of the third age.

rites.name: Venaeriel
rites.text: Venaeriel is a bargain-scribed sigil of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a rite of mending that a practitioner inscribes to borrow a fragment of restorative power and spend it on another's wounds. Its authors bound the act so tightly that no single casting draws more than the faint ember of a candle's warmth from the caster's reserves.

rites.name: Venaela
rites.text: Venaela is the sea-lattice weave of the Alaenneirae tide-courts, a binding that gathers drowned sigils into living coral and holds them fast. Its adepts sing the tangling chords that lock enemies in place, and the weave can convert the pressure of deep trenches into a single crushing pulse.

rites.name: Ilyaniorwen
rites.text: Ilyaniorwen is an arcane principle woven through the third age of Alaenneirae, a binding that lets practitioners reshape flesh into the forms of amphibious wonders. Its quiet discipline recovers slowly, restoring only after a full rest of the body and spirit.

rites.name: Ilyaleireth
rites.text: Ilyaleireth is a mind-binding art practiced in the glass towers of Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, where a practitioner can sway the will of any mortal with a glance and a murmured word. Those who shrug off the sway are thereafter sealed against it for a full hour, a courtesy the old schools call the quiet ward.

rites.name: Venellarora
rites.text: Venellarora is a silver-threaded weaving of the Arcane realm's sixth era, a spell-pattern that folds the leaping-current back on its wielder. Those who learn its loom may step between moments of the air at will, though the trick has never been taught to a child.

rites.name: Ilyelaenys
rites.text: Ilyelaenys is a discipline of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, taught in the sixth era as a way of exploiting a foe's helplessness. Its practitioners strike bodies that have been locked in stillness and sever the fragile threads that bind them, turning a single frozen moment into a sudden surge of harm.

rites.name: Oriarla
rites.text: Oriarla is a sapphire-threaded weave of arcane sigils that a practitioner can tap into, siphoning a stored charge and loosing it as a targeted rending of flesh and bone. In the Alaenneirae reckonings it is counted among the lesser cantrips of the Arcane realm, bound to the blue-cast circles of the E6 age.

rites.name: Venuallora
rites.text: Venuallora is a sensing discipline of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, practiced by wandering ground-wardens who read the pulse of the earth through their soles. It lets a practitioner feel and pinpoint any tremor within thirty feet, so long as both practitioner and source share the same stone, soil, or water. Winged spirits and the incorporeal slip past its reach entirely.

rites.name: Alainnys
rites.text: Alainnys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a duelist-spirit that channels fleeting bursts of spellcraft through the weight of a blade. Its signature is a leap that spans a score of paces in a single heartbeat, ending in a strike that carries the caster's arcane mastery into steel. Scholars of the era regard its power as small in the cosmos but exquisitely precise.

rites.name: Alaalys
rites.text: Alaalys is a concept of rhythm and momentum drawn from the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, where each blow struck in a duel stores a fleeting spark of motion that the dancer can later spend to slip past danger. The Alaalys gathers these sparks as charges that gutter out a minute after the clash ends, rewarding a practitioner who keeps the tempo of combat alive.

rites.name: Ilyannae
rites.text: Ilyannae is a concept of a silent arcane art in the realm of Alaenneirae, where a practitioner strikes from afar with a slender blade-thrown token and, when the foe is pinned by a second adversary or the striker holds the advantage of unseen position, the strike bursts into a tiny cascade of starlight. The tradition is taught in the E6 age, and its power is modest, scaling with the mastery of the one who wields it.

rites.name: Lyenniorlys
rites.text: Lyenniorlys is a quiet discipline of unarmored poise in the Alaenneirae arcane tradition, in which a practitioner's presence bends incoming harm away from the body. Its adepts, taught from the third era onward, learn to let charm and agility together form a living ward.

rites.name: Sileriolora
rites.text: Sileriolora is a dormant arcane technique in the Alaenneirae omniverse, taught by wandering bladesmiths who bind a sliver of their own resonance into two slender blades. Once bound, a thrown blade snaps back to its wielder's palm the instant its strike resolves, letting a single hand strike again and again.

rites.name: Ilyarae
rites.text: Ilyarae is a silver-threaded veil of concept woven through the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, existing as a dormant principle that bends incoming force toward half its strength. In the fourth age of the sixth epoch, it manifests as a reflex-bound ward that answers only when an enemy's blow is clearly seen.

rites.name: Ryinneth
rites.text: Ryinneth is a veiled dancer-mystic of the Arcane realm's sixth era, whose body slips between instants of flame and frost like a reed in a current. Her trained evasion lets her step clear of cataclysmic breath and storms, so that blows meant to scorch or freeze her find only empty air. She is said to have walked out of a collapsing star-forge unscathed, though none could say how.

rites.name: Nuileimys
rites.text: Nuileimys is a dancing art of the Arcane realm, taught in the Alaenneirae era E6 to bards who learn to turn their steps into gifts of courage for allies mid-battle. Its practitioners spend small reserves of rhythm to lift a comrade's blow or guard, and the dance's wider resonance can crack stone when pushed to its limit.

rites.name: Sileirys
rites.text: Sileirys is a drifting dance-engine of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a being of unpredictable grace whose every step rolls the dice of fate. Its movements summon effects no sage can foresee, from petrifying stillness to banishing storms of light. In the third age it is said to have danced a moon out of its orbit.

rites.name: Elaenala
rites.text: Elaenala is a dance-born arcane current in the drifting realm of Alaenneirae, where each spell cast feeds a restless store of rhythmic motion called dazzle-charges. The current answers to the mastery of its wielders, who learn to spend these charges in sweeping, luminous movements that can tear open the ground beneath them.

rites.name: Ilyanaemeth
rites.text: Ilyanaemeth is a concept-born performer of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, bred in the fourth age to thrive amid crowds and carnage alike. Her senses never sleep, so ambushers find no opening against her, and she rises from the dirt almost as fast as she falls.

rites.name: Silionneth
rites.text: Silionneth is a crystalline dance of starlight woven into the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during its fourth age, a choreography that wakes whenever a combatant first steps into the fray. Its practitioners borrow a measure of the world's moving light each time the opening moment of a battle is claimed. The dance is said to answer only to those who have mastered the rhythm of their own heartbeat.

rites.name: Lyimwen
rites.text: Lyimwen is a concept of rhythm-borne encouragement in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a force that can be passed from one willing ally to another during a single fluid motion. Its charges gather in the era of the sixth age and grow stronger with time, turning a quiet gesture into a surge of resolve. Those who learn to hold many charges at once can lift a whole circle of companions toward success.

rites.name: Miemuanniel
rites.text: Miemuanniel is a resonant dance-current that threads through the arcane lattice of Alaenneirae, rewarding practitioners who trade stored rhythm for spellcraft. Its charges accumulate during ordinary casting and can be spent in place of formal slots once a caster reaches the sixth tier of mastery.

rites.name: Mialae
rites.text: Mialae is a dancer-mage of the Alaenneirae whose footwork steadies the threads of her spellwork. In the fourth age of the Arcane realm she is remembered for turning a collapsing bridge of light into a stable arc by sheer rhythm. Her discipline is a quiet art, and its power lies in precision rather than force.

rites.name: Veniorys
rites.text: Veniorys is a concept of arcane choreography in Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, a discipline where practitioners weave known movements into new rhythms that let two enchantments breathe at once. Its adherents spend a measured charge of flourish and a stride of ground to sustain the secondary working, making it a study of rhythm more than raw power.

rites.name: Miineileth
rites.text: Miineileth is a concept of restorative dance in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, where a performer's steps knit broken bodies back together. Its reservoir of mending refills after rest and can be spent in measured portions on any companion within arm's reach.

rites.name: Miamiorlae
rites.text: Miamiorlae is a concept of restorative resonance drawn from the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a power that binds the wounded of a gathering into a single shared pulse. In the Sixth Age it lets its wielder mend every living thing gathered close around them at once, so the closer the crowd, the wider the reach of the mending.

rites.name: Veniona
rites.text: Veniona is a sorcerous discipline in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, in which practitioners bind a radiating field of vital force around themselves that mends the wounded and stalls decay. Its adepts are taught to draw such fields only a few times per rest, for each use spends a portion of the caster's own living warmth. The discipline is prized among the healers of the third age for its dependable, unfueled mercy.

rites.name: Siliona
rites.text: Siliona is a silver-threaded ritual of spiraling dance that gathers scattered light into the wielder's reserves, letting a practitioner who has mastered its steps turn spent flourishes back into restorative vitality. Its disciples measure their renewal by the grace of each motion rather than by any fixed quota.

rites.name: Ilyina
rites.text: Ilyina is the quiet discipline by which Alaenneirae's duelists learned to bend a blade's momentum into a single unbroken arc of light. It is less a power than a habit of posture that the arcane weave of an old era preserved long after its masters were gone.

rites.name: Veneimaleth
rites.text: Veneimaleth is a concept-born force of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a stylized discipline of combat-sorcery that refines a single strike into a sustained surge of focused will. Its practitioners carve their specialty into the air around them, letting each chosen art reshape the way their power is spent.

rites.name: Ilyanora
rites.text: Ilyanora is a dancing discipline of the Arcane realm's sixth age, in which practitioners channel stored rhythm into bursts of extra swordplay. Each stored beat can be spent mid-strike to deliver one additional blow in the same breath.

rites.name: Orienneth
rites.text: Orienneth is the discipline of the threadwarden, a spell-weaving rite in which a caster's last incantation is braided into the edge of a blade so the steel can answer the spell at once. In the Alaenneirae arcane age of E6, its practitioners are prized for turning a single word of power into two strikes.

rites.name: Mialla
rites.text: Mialla is a veil-woven dancer-duelist of the Alaenneirae concordance, whose footwork keeps the currents of the Arcane realm in measured rhythm. Her trained step can coax the world's loose resonance into the edge of her blade, letting a single fated strike split what the eye would call sure. Her rivals speak of the dance more than the wound it leaves.

rites.name: Alaerirleth
rites.text: Alaerirleth is a dragon-blooded trance-walker of the Arcane realm, whose ancestral Dragoon lineage lets its soul surge into a minute of effortless leaping. Its bloodline's heritage is a mere whisper of draconic might, enough to vault the great spires of Alaenneirae but no more. Its trances are rationed, and a long rest must pass before the blood can stir again.

rites.name: Veniomae
rites.text: Veniomae is a kinetic transmutation that lets a combatant launch themselves like a spring, striking a target mid‑air and then landing in a new position. The sudden burst of momentum can shatter armor and bend the local gravity field for a brief instant, giving the user a tactical advantage in close‑quarters aerial combat.

rites.name: Silalerys
rites.text: Silalerys is a concept-born fighting discipline of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a stance-art in which practitioners choose one defining posture and refuse all others. Its adepts reshape ambient magic into a single decisive blow that can unmake a sealed vault wall or a fortified gate. The art is taught across three ages, and its masters are said to strike the very seams where spells hold together.

rites.name: Ryirwen
rites.text: Ryirwen is a vital-thief of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a warrior who siphons the life from foes with each blade-stroke and mends its own wounds with the stolen breath. Its tradition holds that every wound given is a wound borrowed, and that the strongest arms can borrow the most. It rests and renews its borrowed strength at each brief pause in battle.

rites.name: Nuirleimiel
rites.text: Nuirleimiel is an arcane discipline of the Alaenneirae concept realm, practised by duelists who learn to strike twice in the span of a single breath. Its adepts hold that a blade remembers its first wound and sings a second, truer note when called again.

rites.name: Venuariel
rites.text: Venuariel is a dormant concept of Alaenneirae's arcane age, a discipline of sharpened resolve that lets a practitioner strike with a blade or staff beyond ordinary rhythm. Its adherents teach that skill itself becomes a lattice of intent, bending their strikes toward precision rather than raw force.

rites.name: Nuiriel
rites.text: Nuiriel is a sky-dancing discipline in Alaenneirae, practised by warriors who learn to hang motionless at the apex of their leaps. Their ascent is measured in stories of mountain-tops cleaved as they strike from stillness above the clouds.

rites.name: Ilyalionae
rites.text: Ilyalionae is a sky-diving war-spirit of the Arcane realm, who vaults through the high halls of the upper air and descends like a falling star upon her chosen foe. Her strikes carry the weight of a collapsing moon's dust, though she rarely unleashes it fully. She is sworn to the Choir of Lowering Winds.

rites.name: Ilyinora
rites.text: Ilyinora is a thread of pale resonance woven into the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during its sixth era, a concept that tethers the falling weight of a striking body to the aerial bearing of its foe. Those who learn to draw it can bring a winged thing down out of the sky and hold it grounded for a span set by their own physical might.

rites.name: Eluaranora
rites.text: Eluaranora is a bleeding-edge art of the Arcane realm, in which a warrior's blade sings a hymn that opens wounds into rivers of crimson fire that persist across the seasons. Its practitioners are called Threadcutters and are sworn to never use it against the defenseless. Few have mastered its final form, which can drain the lifeblood from a mountain.

rites.name: Silimae
rites.text: Silimae is the unbroken hour of a seventh-spring tide in Alaenneirae, when the moon's second shadow drifts over the wells of the Glass Choir. Those who drink there may refuse a failed fate and call a second thread, though they must bind themselves to whichever answer the weaving gives next.

rites.name: Ryiniel
rites.text: Ryiniel is a sigil of kinetic‑fire fusion that channels a rider’s momentum into a devastating blast. When the bearer leaps, the arc of the fall ignites, showering nearby foes with searing heat while the rider’s own strike gains amplified damage. The effect ends after a single leap, leaving the rider momentarily drained but the battlefield scorched.

rites.name: Lyimiel
rites.text: Lyimiel is a battle-chant of the Arcane realm's fifth-era reckoning, a concept of fury that spreads through an ally's blade-arm. Its bearer kindles the ferocity of companions standing near, so their strikes find vulnerable seams on the highest rolls for a brief span.

rites.name: Silimiel
rites.text: Silimiel is a rite of the Arcane realm's Sixth Epoch, a lattice of sealed ember-glyphs that a wielder awakens when a contest of readiness begins. Each awakening grants two bursts of borrowed vigor that let the bearer outpace time for a single moment.

rites.name: Venalwen
rites.text: Venalwen is a sigil of kinetic suppression that channels a burst of force through a leap, turning a simple jump into a disabling strike. When the bearer lands, the impact can immobilize a foe, while the kinetic energy of the leap is amplified for added damage. The sigil’s power fades after each use, requiring a brief recovery before it can be invoked again.

rites.name: Ryaniel
rites.text: Ryaniel is an arcane scholar-concept in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a mind attuned to the lore of wyrms that has been woven into the memory of the sixth era. Its knowledge of ancient serpentine kings and their hoards makes it a quiet authority in every archive it enters.

rites.name: Siliriorlae
rites.text: Siliriorlae is an arcane technique of the Alaenneirae omniverse, taught in the fourth age of the sixth era as a discipline of piercing through layered wards. Practitioners hurl a focused spear of resonant force that seeks the weakest seam in any defense, letting it pass where stronger blows would rebound.

rites.name: Lyemae
rites.text: Lyemae is a concept-class power of the Arcane realm in the sixth era of Alaenneirae, known as the Wyrmgate Bearing. Its bearer reads the faint seams in a dragon's scales and strikes exactly where the armor thins, while evading the wide blasts that the great wyrms unleash. Its influence is a discipline of precision and nimbleness rather than raw destructive force.

rites.name: Eleilaema
rites.text: Eleilaema is a sun-scorched desert wyrmrider's ritual of kindling inner ember-light, granting a short burst of draconic flame that grows stronger as the practitioner ages in skill. Its breath is a tide of molten sigils that can cook an armored column or boil a shallow lake in a single exhalation.

rites.name: Alaarleirys
rites.text: Alaarleirys is a sensory discipline awakened in the wielders of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during the sixth epoch, letting a practitioner perceive the world through reverberating pulses and lingering shadows of heat. Its bearers can sense foes hidden behind walls and read the subtle currents of the dark, and in the heat of combat they may swiftly sharpen their awareness at will.

rites.name: Nuilleinora
rites.text: Nuilleinora is a concept of ember-scale ferocity that surges through its bearer during a timed trance, granting a brief shield of borrowed vitality. When the trance breaks, the shield dissolves and the bearer's breath carries a sustained fire unbound by ordinary restraint.

rites.name: Eluaniriel
rites.text: Eluaniriel is an arcane discipline in Alaenneirae, a secret art that lets a practitioner braid two sacred trances into one fire. At its height the wielder breathes a scorching storm as a quick, almost reflexive gesture between other acts of war.

rites.name: Elinna
rites.text: Elinna is a discipline of arcane chain-striking in Alaenneirae, taught to duelists who learn to strike a second foe standing beside the first. Its practitioners trade raw force for reach, so the echo blow lands without the full weight of the caster's strength behind it.

rites.name: Eleirlirae
rites.text: Eleirlirae is a concept of arcane wing-manifestation, a spectral pair of draconic pinions that unfurl when a warrior's inner storm is kindled. Born in the Alaenneirae's sixth epoch, it lets its bearer rise and strike again from the open sky. Its fierce surges have sundered mountain ranges.

rites.name: Elionualys
rites.text: Elionualys is an arcane concept of the Alaenneirae omniverse, a gliding discipline of lifting free of a foe's grasp without drawing their retaliation. Practitioners of the sixth era rise along veils of starlight so cleanly that no pursuer can strike back as they depart. It has been taught for four ages as a courtesy between rival mages.

rites.name: Ilyemaenwen
rites.text: Ilyemaenwen is a sky-drake's rite of descent, in which a rider leaps from a cloud-reef and folds the fall into a single breathless plunge. The leap may be ended in the same heartbeat it begins, but only at the cost of one of the rider's stored tides of courage.

rites.name: Ilyemae
rites.text: Ilyemae is a concept of a sealed dark reservoir drawn from the shadowed heart of a wounded star, kept in a black glass vessel that refills only in the hush after a long sleep. Its bearer may spend measured draughts of this gloom as a sorcerous force, each draught hardening a spell's bite against foes who resist it. The Ilyemae vessel has been known to crack open when its reservoir is overdrawn.

rites.name: Nuimerwen
rites.text: Nuimerwen is a concept of arcane shadow-craft in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a discipline where a practitioner draws a reserve of gloom into a blade or fist for a short span of rounds. Its wielders are said to be bound to the dusk that feeds them, and their strikes carry a hollow, withering force that unmakes what the weapon touches.

rites.name: Silerae
rites.text: Silerae is a quiet discipline of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, practiced by wanderers who spend a fragment of their bodily vigor to kindle a reserve of shadowy power within. Adepts describe it as drawing breath from the bones of their own endurance. Its mastery is marked less by spectacle than by the patience to refill the well between storms.

rites.name: Venerae
rites.text: Venerae is the quiet rhythm by which an arcane practitioner strikes a second time before the first blow has finished echoing in the air. Its cadence is taught in the high halls of Alaenneirae, where apprentices learn to answer their own strokes.

rites.name: Veniriel
rites.text: Veniriel is a ward-spirit of the Alaenneirae Arcane realm, a shimmering veil woven from spent vitality and bound to a sworn protector. When called, it draws a sliver of a guardian's endurance into a glowing aegis that shields an ally within thirty paces.

rites.name: Alaema
rites.text: Alaema is a sealed tithe of dusk-glass stored beneath the moving ruins of Alaenneirae, a substance that drinks ambient will and turns it into quiet pressure. In the sixth era its reserves were rationed into discrete draughts that a cultist could spend to make a crowd recoil or to bind two combatants into a forced contest. Scholars still debate whether the dusk-glass remembers the hands that spent it.

rites.name: Venelae
rites.text: Venelae is a bleak thread of sorcery woven through the Alaenneirae, a binding that turns a chosen foe into a lodestone for ruin. For a single minute it sharpens the caster's blows against the marked target until the mark breaks through death or the caster's own collapse. When the marked one falls, the caster draws back a portion of the dark that was spent, a grim reward that must rest before it can be drawn again.

rites.name: Lyinnemora
rites.text: Lyinnemora is a silent, starless current of mind-stuff that runs beneath the dreaming reaches of Alaenneirae, binding sleepers into a single shared thread. Its sages say it was woven when the first dreamers learned to hear one another across the void. It is nothing a mortal can hold, yet it has carried whole councils of minds across a single heartbeat.

rites.name: Veneinelys
rites.text: Veneinelys is a concept of dark force that ripples outward from a bearer's blade in a spiraling sweep, striking everything within a short radius at once. In the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae's sixth era, it is a technique shaped by the ancient dimming of the Hollow Tides, which lets a practitioner spend stored shadow to widen every blow.

rites.name: Lyerora
rites.text: Lyerora is a concept of unbroken attunement, the quiet resolve by which an arcane practitioner keeps their mind from being bent by outside forces. In the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, it is taught in the fourth age as a discipline of inner stillness rather than a physical power.

rites.name: Venaelemae
rites.text: Venaelemae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, an inner darkness that feeds the body of whoever carries it once their strength is worn thin. It sustains its bearer from within, though it cannot raise the fallen. Its wardens claim the gloom is simply a reservoir that refills faster the closer its vessel comes to the edge.

rites.name: Ilyaniel
rites.text: Ilyaniel is a dormant resonance woven into the quiet lattice of Alaenneirae during its sixth age, a presence that stirs only when a bearer nears the edge of their endurance. It answers a final flicker of will by kindling the reserves a body had long forgotten, drawing the weary back from the brink of silence. Its tales speak of wardens who grew too weary to rise, yet rose again.

rites.name: Nuameilla
