rites.text: Nuameilla is a silent spirit of the Arcane realm that drifts between ruined star-forges, lending its sudden bursts of force to any warrior who calls its name in the wind. Each invocation lets it fold through the air to strike beside a foe, and its blows grow heavier as the bearer grows in strength across the ages of Alaenneirae.

rites.name: Siluannama
rites.text: Siluannama is a dread-tempered discipline of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, practiced by those who channel a hidden well of shadow into their bearing. When a practitioner wills it, the darkness within rises to lend weight to a threatening glare, adding its own ominous measure to their presence. Its most feared adepts can make a single frightened glance carry the force of a shattering blow.

rites.name: Lyimeth
rites.text: Lyimeth is the quiet discipline by which a duelist in the drowned cities of Alaenneirae drinks back the shadow it spends in combat. Each strike that bites deep also returns a measure of breath and warmth to the wielder, a bargain taught in the lantern-halls of the sunken quarter.

rites.name: Alairora
rites.text: Alairora is a concept of a silver-threaded dusk that teaches the sky to remember the names of those who fell beneath it. In the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, its dim currents are said to lend a bearer's presence into the weight of every shadow they cast. Dusk-wardens still invoke it when a city needs its nightfall to hold a little longer.

rites.name: Ilyarlae
rites.text: Ilyarlae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a dark current drawn from the bearer's own vitality that can be shaped into a withering cone of necrotic force. Each casting consumes a portion of the caster's life, and the bearer may pour more of it into the flow to strengthen the blast.

rites.name: Veneilioma
rites.text: Veneilioma is a sorrow-engine of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a crystalline lantern of bleeding light that drinks in the wounds of its bearer and turns them into a fierce, bright strength. Its power grows with every gash endured, but it rises only to the limit its bearer's presence can hold, and it shields against the rot of the grave.

rites.name: Miemeth
rites.text: Miemeth is a sealed ward-sense woven into the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during its sixth era, a faculty that lets a bearer sense the moral weight of nearby souls and read the surface currents of their minds. Its power is quiet and bounded, matching the small sphere of a single observer rather than any great force of destruction.

rites.name: Ilyanys
rites.text: Ilyanys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the fourth age of Alaenneirae, a gatherer of spent hardship who turns scars into flame. Its strongest conduit lets it scour a long corridor of the dark with a single breath, drawing strength from the wounds it has survived. It holds back the blows of the world according to how much it has endured.

rites.name: Venaella
rites.text: Venaella is a silent, branching sickness-spirit of the Arcane realm, born in the fourth age of Alaenneirae from the rot that gathered in abandoned wells of shadow. Those who learn its rite can spend a reservoir of dark essence to loose a creeping plague that spreads from one body to the next, seeding illness across whole districts.

rites.name: Alaamwen
rites.text: Alaamwen is a veil-weave of umbral resonance, a concept woven into the lantern-tides of Alaenneirae during its sixth age. Its practitioners draw a shadowed fold from their inner reserve and let it swallow the light around a target. Every use is paid from a finite sump of dimming charge that never refills within a single day.

rites.name: Oriireth
rites.text: Oriireth is a veil-thread weaving of sorrow-light that the Ashen Choir of Alaenneirae teaches to hold a single shadow in the palm. Its wielders pay for each knot of the thread with a measure of their own hidden dusk, and the knot then falls heavy upon one chosen foe for a short, unforgiving while.

rites.name: Nuirys
rites.text: Nuirys is a sealed sigil-lattice that holds the dreams of the Alaenneirae's fourth age, humming with unspent resonance. When its reserves are invoked, a shell of silver echoes folds the caster into a crowd of shimmering doubles that unravel at the first touch.

rites.name: Venuanaelae
rites.text: Venuanaelae is a dim-tide manifestation of the Alaenneirae concept of spent starlight, an ash-lattice that drinks the warmth of fallen suns and returns it as hollow lightning. In the third age of the Sixth Epoch, its adepts channel it through a fixed rite that requires surrendering a measured portion of their inner dark.

rites.name: Elennae
rites.text: Elennae is the sealed resonance that hums beneath the tidal glass of Alaenneirae's reef-cities, a mind-tuned lattice that answers whispered intent. Its wardens learned to coax it into bending a listener's will with a few shaped phrases. The lattice drinks heavily from the cold silence of the deep vaults when it does.

rites.name: Eliomiel
rites.text: Eliomiel is a mote of silver-veiled sorcery woven into the star-lanterns of Alaenneirae during its fourth age. Its adepts draw on a reservoir of dimmed light to fracture bonds of matter and wards alike.

rites.name: Elionnae
rites.text: Elionnae is a dusk-veiled spell of the Arcane realm, shaped by the fourth age of Alaenneirae, that lets a caster draw a measure of the void's chill into their own body. Its drained darkness can be released in a rising tide that quenches the living light of anything it touches.

rites.name: Ryinalwen
rites.text: Ryinalwen is a dimming sigil of the Alaenneirae arcane tradition, a verse of shadowed resonance that binds a caster's own reserved darkness into a sweeping lull of coloured light. Its practitioners learn to spend small stores of night to hold crowds motionless in a rhythmic, swaying trance.

rites.name: Venioramae
rites.text: Venioramae is a discipline of binding light to the edge of a weapon, practiced by sworn wardens of the Alaenneirae reaches during their fourth age. The wielder draws a stored reserve of shadow and converts it into a blade of pure luminous force that can hold for a single cutting stroke.

rites.name: Veneina
rites.text: Veneina is a sealed resonance in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a lattice of cold violet light that hums during the sixth era's quiet winters. Her age of four makes her a child of the lattice, yet she already binds the nearby air into thin silver threads. Her gift is to steady and redirect the hum rather than to strike with it.

rites.name: Elaerys
rites.text: Elaerys is a concept of quiet, hungry dark in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a principle that gathers the pale light of lost stars into a void which devours without sound. Those who learn to bend it spend pieces of their own inner shadow to open a rift that draws distance, warmth and memory into itself.

rites.name: Venaerleth
rites.text: Venaerleth is a dreaming lattice of silver veins that hums beneath the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, storing the quiet of unspoken oaths. Its keepers draw from its reserves to bind a foe's luck in knots that unravel slowly over seasons. Its strength lies in patience rather than ruin.

rites.name: Alaeraeniel
rites.text: Alaeraeniel is a veil-binding discipline in the Alaenneirae omniverse, drawing on the stored night of the Arcane realm's sixth era. Adepts who reach a high threshold of inner reserve may draw a sliver of that night into a shadowed form that can swallow light and sound. It is prized more for concealment and quiet ruin than for open destruction.

rites.name: Ryamella
rites.text: Ryamella is a binding of void-thread woven through the arcane currents of Alaenneirae's fourth age, a discipline that folds stored shadow into barriers of hard, unseen force. Its practitioners lay these walls across the paths of falling stars and rising tides, though the cost of each sealing is paid in a little of the caster's own dark. Scholars of the fifth age still argue over whether it was a gift or a theft.

rites.name: Ryalaennora
rites.text: Ryalaennora is a veil of hunger-light woven by the seventh Choir of Alaenneirae, a quiet gift that drinks warmth from wounds and stitches it into the caster's own flesh. Its practitioners walk the old realms of Arcane with pale, healing hands, and the lore holds that every stolen heartbeat is returned a little, slowly, like a debt paid in ash.

rites.name: Venioleth
rites.text: Venioleth is a lattice of gloaming sigils woven into the bones of Alaenneirae's sixth age, a conduit that lets a bearer draw a single measure of shadow from the deep reservoir and loose it as crushing, grasping force. Scholars of the Arcane realm treat it as a teachable discipline rather than a gift, and its practitioners are rated by how much hunger they can hold without spilling it.

rites.name: Ilyaleth
rites.text: Ilyaleth is a shimmering arcane principle woven through the Alaenneirae omniverse, a conduit of pure sorcery that bends the threads of the Sixth Age. Its reservoirs of hidden voidlight can be drawn upon to hurl bolts of unerring force across distant fields of battle.

rites.name: Eliomaeleth
rites.text: Eliomaeleth is a concept of resonant recoil in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a force that answers a sharp strike with a concussive push. Its power is gathered in the fourth age of the sixth epoch, when wardens of the cloud-cities learned to store storm-pressure in brass shells. It is said that the Eliomaeleth turns a blade's final blow into a shove that can hurl foes back across a hall.

rites.name: Silioruama
rites.text: Silioruama is a concept of focused precision drawn from the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, where aim itself is treated as a force that bends distance. Its practitioners say a single well-placed thought can carry a shot across the Sundering Reach and still strike true.

rites.name: Oriennora
rites.text: Oriennora is a sky-forged lattice of crystalline sigils drifting in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, its drifting shards humming with stored thunder. Its ancient hollow spires channel that charge into ranged discharges that can split the cloud-banks of the upper atmosphere. It is said that whole flotillas of sky-ships once drifted in its wake, each powered by its quiet resonance.

rites.name: Sileirleth
rites.text: Sileirleth is a concept of resonant stillness, the quiet pressure that gathers in a sleeping lantern before dawn. Its bearers draw it into a heavy sigil-cartridge in a single breath, letting the stored light unfold in measured layers that can hold eight such charges at once. The concept is named as the hush between two heartbeats of a sealed hall.

rites.name: Ryerlys
rites.text: Ryerlys is a bardic quality of Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, the art of a voice that makes a crowd of allies seem to speak with one unshakable will. In the E6 era, its adepts are feared as much as trusted, for a wounded foe cannot hide its fear from them. Their presence amplifies the pressure of every word spoken in their company.

rites.name: Venirlys
rites.text: Venirlys is a sealed-off concept of a flame-venting engine that the Alaenneirae scholars keep as a cautionary archive. Its releases are channeled through a single forward-facing blast cone, drawing on the energy of expended charges. It is treated as a discipline rather than a weapon, and its practitioners train to vent force only in the direction they intend.

rites.name: Elionae
rites.text: Elionae is a silver-threaded resonance that hums through the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during its fourth age, binding minds against fear and enchantment. Those it shelters gain an unshakable composure that grows stronger as their wills mature into mastery.

rites.name: Ryirlamae
rites.text: Ryirlamae is a ward-sigil woven into the sleeves of the Ashwake Guild's arcane marksmen, a blue-glass seal that flares to deflect blades aimed at the wearer. Its protection is only summoned when the bearer speaks the word of readiness before the strike lands.

rites.name: Eluarlina
rites.text: Eluarlina is a concept-class arcane resonance that sings through the crystalline veins of the Aelmora Deeps, shaping ambient pressure into a directed concussive wave. It is worked by wardens who strike a tuned blade against stone, releasing a focused line of force that rattles everything in its path.

rites.name: Elennora
rites.text: Elennora is a veiled sigil-weaver of the Alaenneirae reaches, whose craft lets her reclaim half of her spent arcane charges in a single breath once her mastery matures. She may draw on this reserve only once before the deep rest that restores her full stores.

rites.name: Silareth
rites.text: Silareth is a concept-realm force that wears the name of a fallen star-warden, its presence a pale sheen of sleeping iron across the Arcane sky of the fourth age. It can seize the momentum of any mind-bound creature and pin it to the ground with a pulse of resonant thunder that rattles bone without breaking it.

rites.name: Lyeriniel
rites.text: Lyeriniel is a concept of a stilled breath, a quiet resonance that dulls the reflexes of anything it touches in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during the sixth era. Those it strikes find their instincts hushed and their counterstrikes stranded until the next turning of the age.

rites.name: Venaneimys
rites.text: Venaneimys is a ward-sigil etched into the shell-plates of the glass-tortoises of the Hollow Reach, a discipline that lets a warded bearer convert incoming harm into a pulse of stored resonance. Its practitioners are called Shellwardens, and they hold that every blow taken is a debt the body can repay outward. The pulse rolls out in a ring that shakes everything nearby.

rites.name: Venamwen
rites.text: Venamwen is a silver ward-thread woven by the Ashen Choir of Alaenneirae, bound so that a fallen bearer may refuse the final dark a few times over. Each refusal leaves the wearer clinging to a single flicker of life, and the thread mends itself fully after rest. Its keepers say it has never once been broken.

rites.name: Silarae
rites.text: Silarae is a concept within the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a channeled discharge of elemental fury that a practitioner can focus into a tempest of flame, frost, or storm. Its power swells as the wielder ascends through the ranks of the Veil, growing from a spark into a cataclysm that can shatter stone and scorch the sky.

rites.name: Venuarlys
rites.text: In the cosmic dance of the Venuarlys, the E6 era's Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, concepts like 'Gravity' are mere suggestions. The Venuarlys, born of the 'Munitions' current, grants instant, boundless movement and amplifies the first strike's force.

rites.name: Silaelenae
rites.text: Silaelenae is a wandering duelist-smith of the Alaenneirae concept realm, whose silver gunblades hold stored starlight in their chambers. When she strikes true, she can release the captured light as a ring of elemental storm that spreads from her in a sphere of ruin. Her songs are said to have toppled gates a thousand leagues away.

rites.name: Silaelinna
rites.text: Silaelinna is a sealed arcane discipline of the Alaenneirae concordance, a bonded technique that grows stronger as its adept climbs the ladder of mastery. At its highest tier the practitioner bends the terms of each blow, letting a single strike carry the unmaking force of shadow, dawn, or raw will.

rites.name: Alailys
rites.text: Alailys is an arcane concept in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a ritual of resonant striking that lets a practitioner's blade sing twice on a single swing once mastered. Its devotees measure their skill by how many charges of stored thunder they can coax from the steel before it cools.

rites.name: Elilwen
rites.text: Elilwen is a concept-born arcane discipline of the Alaenneirae omniverse, practiced by wardens who channel fractured starlight through brass casings. Its adepts grow a near-mystical steadiness at close range, letting them strike with full force even when enemies press against them.

rites.name: Siluariel
rites.text: Siluariel is an arcane concept of the Alaenneirae omniverse, a lattice of humming threads that fray whenever a mind bends fate in its favor. Four ages old, it is a crafted lens whose focus spends stored charges to reroll a stumbling outcome, and the rerolled result must be accepted as final.

rites.name: Silionneth
rites.text: Silionneth is a crystalline mirror-engine that drifts through the arcane tides of Alaenneirae, bending hostile wards into targeting lenses. Its keepers call it the Unguarded Eye, for it strikes where no shield seems to stand.

rites.name: Nuemys
rites.text: Nuemys is an arcane technique in the Alaenneirae cosmos, a discipline of focusing ranged resonance so it may be wielded as if at arm's length. Practitioners of the E6 age describe it as a stance that collapses distance rather than a single spell.

rites.name: Venela
rites.text: Venela is a sacred siege-engine of the Arcane realm, a bronze cannon-organ that fires resonant shells through the quiet aisles of a dead city. Its gunners, called the Ringed Choir, believe each loaded charge holds a fragment of a fallen god's breath, and expending extra charges in a single volley is treated as a hymn of ruin.

rites.name: Orienae
rites.text: Orienae is an arcane concept in the realm of Alaenneirae, an ability that lets a practitioner ready a strike so that an opponent's footing is briefly seized. Those who master it turn a single prepared blow into a lock on the target's stride, a discipline taught in the quiet ateliers of E6 locales.

rites.name: Nuenaerora
rites.text: Nuenaerora is a quiet discipline of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, practiced by wardens who untangle the sealing engines that guard ancient vaults. Its adherents can loosen any mechanism of thought or brass by reading its hidden tension, though the bindings they release sometimes hold far worse things than gold.

rites.name: Venamae
rites.text: Venamae is a concept of a palm-sized sentinel charm, crafted in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during its sixth era, that holds a single ward-vigil until it is rekindled by a night of rest. Its wardens affix it to thresholds or leave it to watch a small chamber of air, and it rouses its keeper the instant anything crosses its gaze.

rites.name: Venaereth
rites.text: Venaereth is a lattice of resonant sigil-engines that hum beneath the drowned cities of Alaenneirae, its gears of crystallized silence turning only when a mind wills them to. Its tenders wield attuned contraptions whose hit-chance and resistance-thresholds are set by their own cleverness and seasoning. The engines are said to remember every design ever built upon them.

rites.name: Lyannae
rites.text: Lyannae is an old discipline of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a practice in which the wielder learns to shorten the pause between drawing and releasing a bow, sling, or crossbow until the reload vanishes. Those who master it are said to fire without the hesitation that once limited every archer in the Era of Six Thresholds. Its adepts are prized as scouts and sentinels, and its teachings are kept in quiet orders.

rites.name: Oriinneth
rites.text: Oriinneth is a discipline of the Arcane Lattice in Alaenneirae, taught to scholars who learn to quiet their thoughts until the mind can steer the body faster than instinct allows. Adepts of the sixth circle find their strides lengthening and their reactions sharpening as mental resolve floods the nerves.

rites.name: Silenys
rites.text: Silenys is an arcane concept in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a discipline of reading the hidden intent in engineered things, granting its practitioners an uncanny sense for how gears, wards, and built places were meant to function. In the Sixth Era it is studied in the quiet archives of the Ninth Circle, where adepts learn to follow the faint resonance a living body leaves within stone corridors and crowded streets.

rites.name: Ryalys
rites.text: Ryalys is a concept of precision-targeting, a discipline in which a marksman's shot is aimed at a specific bodily point to unmake it in a chosen way. Its practitioners in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae can strike the nerve, the heart, or the joint of a foe at range, and the effect lingers until a deliberate counter-action frees the target. The discipline is taught by the Eighth Concordance and held in old Machinist esteem.

rites.name: Ryerleth
rites.text: Ryerleth is an arcane concept of the Alaenneirae, a fleeting skill of evasion that bends the intent of incoming force so the blow slides past its mark. Its practitioners are said to step sideways out of the path of ruin, leaving the attacker grasping at a reflection. It is measured by how many times a soul can dodge before exhausting its grace and needing rest.

rites.name: Lyilora
rites.text: Lyilora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a ricochet-bound rhythm that lets a shooter's reaction turn one successful strike into a second, unspent echo. It belongs to the fourth age of the sixth era, where marksmanship is treated as a kind of quiet law. Its echoes travel only as far as a hand's breadth beyond the first mark.

rites.name: Lyerlama
rites.text: The Lyerlama is a palm-sized spherical charm of pale ember-glass, grown in the sunken orchards of Alaenneirae, that its wielders carry as a last defense against death. When a bearer falls to nothing, the charm wakes on its own and knits flesh back together with a pulse of verdant light. It can be hurled at a fallen ally to rouse them, and it renews itself each time its holder rests.

rites.name: Lyiruanys
rites.text: Lyiruanys is a slender ebony cane whose silver tip hums with veiled light, able to render its holder and every companion within a short reach unseen for one minute. Those hidden must stay pressed close to the staff, or the veil tears away from them, and the cane falls silent until a full night's stillness restores it.

rites.name: Alailamys
rites.text: Alailamys is a dormant resonance woven through the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during the sixth age, a silent tuning that lets a practitioner reset the wards of a crafted device in a single breath. Each attunement drains the bearer's inner stillness, so the gift can only be drawn again after a full night of quiet rest.

rites.name: Silaneth
rites.text: Silaneth is a concept of the Arcane realm's sixth era, a lens-bearing craft that lets a watcher pierce distance and read far horizons. Its gift is perception and reach rather than destruction, so its feats are measured in how far the eye can carry. The entry is modest in scale, bending sight across leagues without ever reshaping the land itself.

rites.name: Nuerlaeleth
rites.text: Nuerlaeleth is an arcane discipline of the Alaenneirae omniverse, taught in the fourth age of the E6 era as a way for marksmen to channel stored force through a rail of humming crystal. Its adepts gain a second reserve of charges as they mature, and a pair of lensed visors lets them strike at the farthest reaches of their range without loss of aim.

rites.name: Lyemae
rites.text: Lyemae is a sealed chord of starlight that the mages of Alaenneirae keep bound inside glass vessels, released only in moments when the weave of fate bends toward a decisive strike. When it breaks free, the blow it guides lands twice as deep as any ordinary stroke, arcing through the marrow of the age's fiercest champions.

rites.name: Silaemelora
rites.text: Silaemelora is a silver circlet of the Arcane realm's sixth age, worn to let its bearer perceive through distant sentinel crystals as though standing in their place. Its wearer hears the whispers of the glass eyes and watches the valley from a hundred vantage points at once. The circlet is said to have been forged by a choir of astronomers who wished to watch the sky without climbing a single tower.

rites.name: Venaelana
rites.text: Venaelana is a sigil-bound weaving of arcane force that a Veilmaster sets into a ring of crystal lenses, each lens holding a distinct posture of the weaver's will. Once fixed, the lenses let the bound constructs shift their stance in the same moment they act, folding a second deliberate motion into a single breath of combat. Its effect is strongest in the turning of the Alaenneirae deep-sky ruins, where the ambient current is thickest.

rites.name: Ryamae
rites.text: Ryamae is an arcane discipline in which a practitioner anchors crystalline sentinels called turrets that can briefly surge into a heightened state of power. Once the surge has run its course, the caster must rest fully before the ability can be called upon again.

rites.name: Nuemeirliel
rites.text: Nuemeirliel is a sealed resonance-lens of the Arcane realm, a crystalline bulb that teaches its bearer to tune the detonating shells of their ordnance so allies pass through the blast unharmed. Within the Alaenneirae omniverse it is prized by siege engineers who must fight beside the very forces they bombard.

rites.name: Mienwen
rites.text: Mienwen is a tide-glass lattice of sealed ember-runes drifting through the Alaenneirae's marsh-fog, each mote tuned to the heartbeat of nearby life. Its wardens once used it as a silent trap, letting a charge rest dormant until a foot or wing crossed its tuned radius. It remains a feared relic of the sunken lantern-courts.

rites.name: Ryareilleth
rites.text: Ryareilleth is the Arcane craft of the sealed bomb-smiths of Alaenneirae, who learn to store volatile sparks in brass shells and refresh their stock each time they rest. In the eleventh year of training a smith may carry twice as many shells and keep two of every specialty charge at once. Their plain shells also gain the ability to burst outward across a fifteen-foot sphere when called.

rites.name: Mierlannora
rites.text: Mierlannora is a silver-threaded aiming lattice worn by the wardens of the Veyl Spires, letting a practitioner bind a fleeting hunch of fate into a single piercing lance of light. Its skill rests on patience, for a warden must hold a target's gaze across a span of sixty paces before the bolt is loosed. Those who master it say the true weapon is the stillness that comes before the release.

rites.name: Miimiola
rites.text: Miimiola is a sentient cluster of crystalline resonance-lattices that drifts through the upper strata of Alaenneirae, singing harmonics that bend ambient mana into lattice-threads. Once every four centuries it fixes itself to a tectonic seam and drinks the planet's slow heat, becoming briefly immovable while its song grows terrifyingly precise.

rites.name: Mienneth
rites.text: Mienneth is a resonant tonic-current that pulses through the bones of anyone standing close to a chosen focal point, sharpening their strikes for a short while. Its practitioners in the cloud-spired archives of Alaenneirae brew it as a battlefield stimulant rather than a weapon, though it can briefly amplify the bursts of nearby thunder-vents.

rites.name: Silarlae
rites.text: Silarlae is a crystalline resonance-art that channels the hum of storm-glass into concentric pulses of violet arc, shaped by a practitioner's mind rather than any mechanism. Its adepts are said to tune the air around them until nearby living things feel a sudden, crackling jolt that tests their reflexes.

rites.name: Ryamora
rites.text: Ryamora is a lattice of crystallized storm-glass channels used by Alaenneirae's Arcane artisans to focus a sharp, branching discharge at a single chosen foe within a short reach. Its controlled bolts are calibrated for duels and skirmishes rather than sieges, so their force stays modest and precise.

rites.name: Mialae
rites.text: Mialae is a tireless sentinel-spirit bound into a brass lattice of wards, which anchors itself to bedrock and weaves a ring of crackling storm-light around its post. Those who cross the ring are stunned by the discharge, though its guardian rewards the wary with reduced harm. Its roots hold it fast, so it cannot be moved without first being released.

rites.name: Eluana
rites.text: Eluana is a lattice of resonant aether-glass spun by the Veil-weavers of Alaenneirae to hold the weather of the high spires in place. Her presence sharpens the will of nearby allies, lending their arcane craft a brief, brilliant edge.

rites.name: Lyaniel
rites.text: Lyaniel is a resonance-craft drawn from the tidal hymns of the Alaenneirae deeps, where an adept stores spent sorrow as tuned sparks. Each adept carries a ring of such sparks that refill only after a night of stillness or a full dawn of rest.

rites.name: Venioma
rites.text: Venioma is the quickening rite of the Arcane realm, a concept that lets a caster in the Alaenneirae omniverse compress a spell's gathering into a single swift flicker of will. Its power is bounded so that only the humblest incantations can be hastened, keeping the rite a matter of tempo rather than raw ruin.

rites.name: Miela
rites.text: Miela is the quiet tithe of the Alaenneirae arcane choirs, a resonance that stirs when a mind first reaches for the storm of battle and finds its reserves spent. In that instant it lends back a measure of hoarded starlight, swelling the caster's will just as the first clash begins. Scholars call it the Last Breath of the Score.

rites.name: Nuanae
rites.text: Nuanae is a veiled discipline of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a rhythm of two woven sigils that a practitioner may chant in tandem once they have mastered the Sevenfold Pulse. Its counterpart is a lingering exhaustion that must be restored through quiet rest before the rhythm can be sung again.

rites.name: Ilyarlionna
rites.text: Ilyarlionna is an arcane discipline of the Alaenneirae omniverse, a technique by which a practitioner collapses the space between themselves and a chosen adversary in a single surge of luminous momentum. The art is taught to those who have bound their inner reserves of flair into disciplined pulses. It was refined in the lattice-cities of the Ember Coast over the sixth era.

rites.name: Elaleth
rites.text: Elaleth is a discipline of conversational artistry practiced in the Alaenneirae courts, where a speaker learns to reshape a listener's mood with a turn of phrase. Adepts may spend a stored flourish of wit to cast a fresh attempt at any act of persuasion, and they gain a permanent mastery of one social art of their choosing. The discipline is taught as a craft, not an inborn gift.

rites.name: Veniollora
rites.text: Veniollora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a discipline in which a duelist's blade and sorcery fuse into one motion. In the third age of the sixth era, practitioners of the style are said to vault backward over lesser foes while hurling a bolt of pressured force, though larger opponents can still halt the leap.

rites.name: Sileneth
rites.text: Sileneth is a bladed silver ring-sword forged in the drifting tide-halls of Alaenneirae, where the wielder's attuned will fuses with the metal until it answers a whisper and returns to the palm. Each strike it guides can be sharpened by a spent spark of inner flame, driving a pulse of unseen force through the blow. Its old makers claimed it could cut the tether between a sleeping god and its dream.

rites.name: Orierla
rites.text: Orierla is a loremaster of the Vaelith Circle who has bent her own nerves into a looping conduit, letting her weave a dozen arcane workings in the time it takes most casters to draw breath. Her quickened spellcraft turns each ignition into a cascade that echoes across the ley-lines of Alaenneirae.

rites.name: Silemeth
rites.text: Silemeth is a pattern of unspent resonance that the Alaenneirae drift between the ringing stars, a currency of focused will rather than a physical substance. Its keepers can draw it from their own breath to kindle the arts that once held the dying suns in place.

rites.name: Silanniel
rites.text: Silanniel is a resonance woven into the bloodlines of Alaenneirae's arcane scholars, a faint pull of the mind that lets a willing voice carry further than words alone. Those who awaken it at the sixth turning of their training find that a spark of inner flair can tilt how strangers weigh their promises and pleas. It is a subtle art, rarely noticed by its targets.

rites.name: Oriannora
rites.text: Oriannora is a rule of hidden tactics practised by veteran spellweavers of the Arcane realm, who learn to turn a minor cantrip's sting into an opening for greater magic. A single spent flair point lets the caster sharpen an aimed bolt against a wounded foe or leave that foe fumbling against incoming spells until the turn closes. It is a technique of nuance rather than raw ruin.

rites.name: Lyanneth
rites.text: Lyanneth is a resonance-art of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, where a practitioner folds a spent spell's residual glow back into their own reserve of flair. Scholars of the third age regard it as a quiet discipline, measured less by spectacle than by the discipline to refuse overflow.

rites.name: Oriilae
rites.text: Oriilae is a concept of swift spellweaving, the discipline of layering many small enchantments into a single breathless flourish of light and force. Practitioners who master it can unleash cascades of incantations faster than thought can follow, each strand reinforcing the last.

rites.name: Lyalwen
rites.text: Lyalwen is a distraction technique practiced by dueling-masters of the Arcane realm, where a performer weaves glimmering sigils through the air to hold a foe's gaze. While the trick lasts, every blade their companions raise bites with sharper focus.

rites.name: Elirlae
rites.text: Elirlae is a silver-thread art of borrowed composure, in which a teacher weaves a sliver of their own presence into an ally's voice for a brief hour of grace. The practice is said to have been taught first to couriers who needed to win the trust of hostile courts. Its bearer must rest before weaving it again.

rites.name: Elameth
rites.text: Elameth is a concept of charismatic fervor, a radiant presence that kindles courage in nearby allies so their strikes burn with extra force for a short span. It draws on the warmth of a single word spoken in a crowded hall, a spark that spreads through everyone close enough to hear it. Its power is bounded by proximity and by the brief window in which its kindled fire lasts.

rites.name: Ryanneimiel
rites.text: Ryanneimiel is a tactical method of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, where a commander spends spark-reserve to lift a trailing companion forward through the flow of battle. It may be invoked only once before the wielder rests anew.

rites.name: Eluarwen
rites.text: Eluarwen is the bound voidsent that answers a warrior's plea at the edge of a massacre, a featureless shard of hunger that trades its strength for a sliver of the living world. Its contract lets it be recalled through a tarnished momento, though it returns each time changed a little more by mortal grief. Its power is measured less by the scale of its strikes than by the quiet horror of what it has already swallowed.

rites.name: Ryareth
rites.text: Ryareth is an arcane concept in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a doctrine of reaping that binds a practitioner's will to the moment a living thread is severed. Adepts of Ryareth choose a focus that shapes how the severance is carried out, whether by blade, by sealed vessel, or by spoken decree. Its power is measured in the weight of endings rather than in raw force.

rites.name: Elemae
rites.text: Elemae is a quiet arcane discipline in the realm of Alaenneirae, where practitioners learn to borrow the lingering sight of the unseen and the murmur of the departed without spending the reserves they keep for battle. Its adepts are said to gain a single unbidden glimpse each day, enough to pierce a veil or hear a final word. The discipline is taught in the third age as a gentle counterpart to more forceful sorceries.

rites.name: Alaenneth
rites.text: Alaenneth is a hollow-hearted warden of the Alaenneirae, an arcane realm where dying stars are kept as lanterns by quiet keepers. Born in the third age of the sixth era, Alaenneth tends the cold embers that drift between the worlds and answers only to the slow silence of dusk.

rites.name: Ilyanniel
rites.text: Ilyanniel is a dusk-wandering warden of the Veil of Ashes who binds the dying light of fallen stars into strikes that drain the courage of anyone they touch. Their blades carry a hollow, grey echo that rattles the spirit even when the body feels nothing. Ilyanniel walks the borders between the living realm and the quiet dead, guiding lost souls to rest.

rites.name: Venarelys
rites.text: Venarelys is a concept of a void-bound warding presence, a silent avatar that a bearer calls forth and may release at the edge of ruin to restore a fraction of their strength. Its banishment is costly, and it cannot be summoned again until the bearer has known a full night of rest in the Arcane realm of the fourth age.

rites.name: Lyelora
rites.text: Lyelora is a concept of hungry dusk-tide, a necrotic force that rides the edge of a blade when a striker lands true, spreading its chill to nearby foes. Its strength swells with the depth of the bound slot, and when joined to a void-born host it sweeps outward in a long cone of withering shadow.

rites.name: Elerora
rites.text: Elerora is a drifting sigil-current woven into the upper sky of Alaenneirae, a brief lift of wind-stitched glyphs that lets a bearer rise and glide for a minute. Its strength grows with the layers of threadwork poured into it, quickening each traveler's stride as the glyphs hum.

rites.name: Alaereimys
rites.text: Alaereimys is a silent warden of the Arcane realm's fourth age, a figure who lends its void-born shape to hosts who can bend the abyss into a weapon. Once a host reaches their eleventh rung of mastery, the warden answers a single whispered command and strikes on its own, letting the host spend a fleeting moment on another act.

rites.name: Ryama
rites.text: Ryama is a concept of void-binding wardcraft in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, where a warden's blade drags a shroud of grave-cold dark that stretches its reach and punishes any foe who strays into it. The Eighth-Era wardens regard it as a discipline of restraint rather than conquest.

rites.name: Silaeneth
rites.text: Silaeneth is an arcane gift of the Alaenneirae omniverse that lets a caster project their conjured workings through a distant reflection of themselves. Each projection can be drawn only a few times before the reservoir of sympathy must be refilled by rest. Ancient scribes recorded that the reflections were never harmed by the powers they carried.

rites.name: Venereirlae
rites.text: Venereirlae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a bond between a mind and a distant echo of itself that can be entered at will. Its adepts speak across the gap in thought and borrow the echo's senses, surrendering their own sight and hearing while they look through another's eyes.

rites.name: Sileiriel
rites.text: Sileiriel is a veiled resonance of the Alaenneirae weave, a rule-bending craft that lets a practitioner split their will into a second, void-born shadow. The shadow answers the same call twice in a single breath, striking with a pair of silent blows that unmake whatever they touch.

rites.name: Alaerys
rites.text: In the ethereal realm of Elysium, the entity known as Alaerys, 'The Soulweaver', harvests the essence of the deceased to fuel its arcane tapestry, storing up to 6 essences and casting 'Echoes of Life' spells by expending twice the required essence level.

rites.name: Ryirlys
rites.text: Ryirlys is a quiet grammar of bells and bone-rhythms in the Alaenneirae cycle, a rule that lets the wakeful hear the sleeping dead in the marrow of stone. It was codified in the sixth age as a teaching-song, and its practitioners strike resonant tones that unmake the hollow between thought and matter.

rites.name: Eleinneth
rites.text: Eleinneth is a mind-art of the Arcane realm in the sixth era of Alaenneirae, a discipline that lets a practitioner sharpen their grasp of hidden lore once they reach the seventh rung of study. Those who master it can read the currents of ancient memory and the quiet language of the sick, honing a single chosen discipline until it becomes second nature.

rites.name: Silualys
rites.text: Silualys is a thread of cold-burning spite woven into the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during the sixth era, where it binds itself to a wandering keeper and whispers judgment into the ears of the unwary. Its marks linger like frost on the mind, weakening the resolve of anyone who dares stand against its bearer.

rites.name: Miennaellys
rites.text: Miennaellys is a shadowmist concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae's seventh age, a veil-walker who slips out of blows like smoke escaping a hand. Its dark mist answers any incoming strike, carrying the body a short distance to a clear place in sight. Those who host its void avatar can summon the veil without paying the usual toll of a soul.

rites.name: Venualiel
rites.text: Venualiel is a contract-bound voidsent that answers the grief of a massacre, lending its strength to a single mortal through a sealed momento. Its pact is ancient and quiet, yet when it is commanded to unmake something it does so with terrible completeness.

rites.name: Veninys
rites.text: Veninys is a silent geometry of gravitational resonance that settles across the mind of whoever grips a tool with both hands, sharpening each blow until it finds the flaw in the world's armor. In the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, its followers say the cosmos itself keeps a ledger of perfect strikes, and Veninys is the hand that writes it.

rites.name: Ilyerlora
rites.text: Ilyerlora is a discipline of stillness practiced by wardens of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, in the third age of the sixth era. Its adherents draw protective resonance from body and spirit when they go unarmored, shedding metal to let their own calm become their shield.

rites.name: Elaleth
rites.text: Elaleth is a concept-level Arcane practice in the Alaenneirae omniverse, in which a practitioner draws loose ambient force into a short-lived inner reservoir and releases it through a single disciplined stroke. Its charges swell with each measured pause and vanish if left idle too long, making it a tool of rhythm rather than raw accumulation.

rites.name: Lyarleth
rites.text: Lyarleth is a bleeding-rose swordsman of Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, whose fencing carves crimson blossoms that refuse to close in the victim's flesh. Its signature technique, a wound that festers for a minute unless the foe fights through the pain, is taught only to those who have mastered their inner breath. Lyarleth's sword can cleave the bonds between a continent's rivers and the sea in a single act.

rites.name: Lyinaerys
rites.text: Lyinaerys is a whispered inheritance of the Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, a discipline of reading the cadence of disciplined minds. Its practitioners sense the rigid rhythms of soldiers and oath-bound orders, bending their attention toward common ground. The sway it grants is subtle, but in an age of fractured legions it can turn a hostile captain into an ally.

rites.name: Siluariel
rites.text: Siluariel is a wind-woven sigil of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a concept of keen sight that lets an archer's arrow find its mark across longer distances. Its power is quiet and precise, felt more than seen. It has existed for four ages of the E6 era, guiding hunters and scouts through the high ridges.

rites.name: Elira
rites.text: Elira is a concept of a mind-forged balance, a state in which a practitioner's raw force and quiet insight are woven into a single weave of thought. In the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, those who attain it may take up two new disciplines of reasoning, presence, or perception, each one a thread added to the loom of their will. Its creators hold that a mind and a fist cannot be split without ruin.

rites.name: Veneillera
rites.text: Veneillera is a wind-sigil ritual of the Arcane realm, drawn as a silver halo that a practitioner releases in a single sweeping gesture. Its pulse rings out around the caster, bending the air and scattering all nearby foes who fail to brace against it. Those who resist still feel its echo, though far more faintly.

rites.name: Oriariel
rites.text: Oriariel is a quiet discipline in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, practised by wanderers who tune their breath to the drifting voices of the land. Adepts earn the ability to question the rivers, the stones and the restless dead, drawing answers at the cost of a full night's rest before they may ask again.

rites.name: Ryerys
rites.text: Ryerys is a quiet arcane discipline in which a wanderer who spends healing dice during a brief rest carries that restored vigor into the next moment of danger, storing a single charge of Sen. The charge is released as a sudden burst at the first clash of the next battle, making every short rest a deliberate wager on the coming fight.

rites.name: Nuemilora
rites.text: Nuemilora is a dormant resonance-art of the Alaenneirae arcane orders, awakened by a practitioner gripping a shaft of gleaming ore in both hands. Once the hold is secured and the weapon sings, every swing finds the seams where a foe's defenses are thinnest, so strikes in the top three rolls of the dice land as perfect breaches.

rites.name: Nuirlae
rites.text: Nuirlae is a bound rhythm of stored resolve that a practitioner pours into a single planted stance, each saved charge becoming a strike unleashed from the same unmoving ground. The lore says the charges echo the heartbeat of the wielder's conviction, and no traveler who spent their reserve ever walked away from the spot.

rites.name: Ilyarlora
rites.text: Ilyarlora is a sealed discipline of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, where a practitioner can briefly turn their own flesh into a channel for drawn-in Sen energy. Once a long rest has passed, the channel reopens, though it can be claimed only once per cycle.

rites.name: Mialerwen
rites.text: Mialerwen is a silvermoth-song, a spiral of resonant glass-chime that the Arcane choirs of Alaenneirae have cultivated for three ages to shear memory from stone. It is not a person but a tuned discipline, bound to the sixth-era lattice of the Quiet Vaults. Its gravest act can unmake a vault's foundations in a single note.

rites.name: Alaarinnys
rites.text: Alaarinnys is a wind-bound technique in the Alaenneirae omniverse, where practitioners fold stored Sen into hissing blades of air that strike from a distance. Tutors teach that the blades cut true because they are shaped by the same breath that carries thunder. Adepts who master the form learn to release a pair of such strikes in a single motion.

rites.name: Miileirae
rites.text: Miileirae is a concept of arcane resonance in the realm of Alaenneirae, where a practitioner's steady will lets them lend a fraction of their trained edge to raw physical tasks such as lifting, leaping, and enduring. It amplifies strength into longer strides and lends hard-won resilience to any effort that lacks prior mastery. Its magnitudes are modest, reflecting an art of refinement rather than cataclysm.

rites.name: Alainae
rites.text: Alainae is a fencing-discipline of the Alaenneirae, a drill of pure focus in which a practitioner unleashes a flurry of blades across a fan of air before them. Its name is the old word for a breath held until the strike lands. Its scope is that of a single battlefield, never reaching beyond the reach of a human sweep.

rites.name: Eliolae
rites.text: Eliolae is a quiet discipline of the Alaenneirae's arcane orders, a way of tuning the will so that a single held breath of resolve sharpens every blow a bearer lands. Practitioners spend one stored measure of Sen to keep that clarity burning through a full turn of combat. It is a mindful art rather than a raw force, yet its effects reach the scale of a continent when wielded by the most seasoned.

rites.name: Venirleth
rites.text: Venirleth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a reflex-bound duelist-art that answers each blow aimed at its bearer with a counterstrike born of the same instant. It belongs to the sixth era, when its practitioners learned to turn a foe's momentum back upon them.

rites.name: Elanneth
rites.text: Elanneth is an arcane concept woven into the age of Alaenneirae's fourth era, where unseen snares and sealed passages are the chief dangers of forgotten vaults. Its practitioners sense the faint stirrings of hidden mechanisms and the seams of concealed doors long before any hand touches them. Its mastery lies in reading the quiet wrongness that betrays a trap.

rites.name: Venema
rites.text: Venema is a rune-carved ward-lattice that lets a duelist bend incoming blade-fate by drawing on stored sen charges, raising their guard by a point per charge. It must be invoked before the strike resolves, so the wise wield it as a prelude to a clash rather than a last-moment plea.

rites.name: Venuana
rites.text: Venuana is a sealed arcane discipline in Alaenneirae, practiced by wardens who learn to answer blows faster than they fall. Its adepts can strike twice in the span of a single moment of strife, and their gaze pierces the shallow veil of mundane steel.

rites.name: Silionwen
rites.text: Silionwen is an arcane technique of the Alaenneirae omniverse, a lightning-swift lunge drawn from a practitioner's inner reserve of Sen, letting its user cross a short distance in an instant and strike before the foe can turn. Its burst is measured in the quiet fraction of a sword's whistle, the mark of a duelist's art rather than a catastrophe.

rites.name: Ilyinema
rites.text: Ilyinema is a quiet art of borrowed craft, a discipline in which a practitioner learns to take a little from every trade they cross. Its adepts move through the world with masks of posture and speech, reading locks and lies alike as a single kind of lattice to be gently loosened. It is less a weapon than a patient way of walking unseen through the seams of a realm.

rites.name: Oriirualwen
rites.text: Oriirualwen is a fighting technique taught in the highest halls of Alaenneirae, where a warrior who has reached the tenth rung of mastery may spend a single stored charge of Sen to strike and retreat in one motion. The strike is aimed with a sharpened sense of the opponent's guard, and the withdrawal leaves no opening for reprisal.

rites.name: Mielirlys
rites.text: Mielirlys is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a way of reading the hidden seams in an opponent's stance that lets a practitioner strike where defenses are thinnest. Its adepts draw on a reserve called Sen, spending a single charge to sharpen every blow they land until their next turn.

rites.name: Lyarae
rites.text: Lyarae is a Sage's discipline of tethered Nouliths, tiny flying constructs that drink the aether of their operator's body. Its ambition is sustaining a swarm of such devices that each feed from the same living source. Lyarae's craft is measured in the small and personal, so its feats stay within a city's reach.

rites.name: Siluanniel
rites.text: Siluanniel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae's sixth era, a weapon-art in which a bonded lattice of tuned aether-shards is turned outward as a directed spark of pressure. Practitioners say the focus is patience rather than force, and the craft is taught to the young before they are allowed near any living mechanism.

rites.name: Venerleirae
rites.text: Venerleirae is a concept-kind arcane principle in the omniverse of Alaenneirae, described as a lattice of resonant sigils that a scholar may tune toward war, warding, or the weaving of spells. Its strength lies in redirecting the unbound magnitude of its sigils according to the discipline of whoever wields them. It belongs to the third age of the sixth era, where such disciplines are taught in severe academies.

rites.name: Ryineila
rites.text: Ryineila is a silver-threaded wind-current spirit bound into the sky-lanes above the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during its fourth age. It answers to those who have grown great enough to carry its gliding weave, lending them the freedom of the air in quiet measure.

rites.name: Veneima
rites.text: Veneima is a dormant resonance-art in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, practised by those who have learned to hold a lattice of stored thunder steady inside their bodies. Its adepts can briefly rewind their own spent reserves, though the strain of doing so forces a full night of stillness before the trick may be repeated.

rites.name: Ilyenwen
rites.text: Ilyenwen is a sentient chorus of luminous lattice-spirits that bind themselves to the willing and ring as a single resonant bell when their tethers are sung. Their cone-shaped discharges are small, precise and disciplined, shaping the world to shrink the scale of what they can truly harm. Within Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, they are remembered as the gentle guardians who never sought to outshine the stars.

rites.name: Venimae
rites.text: Venimae is a silent arcane discipline that teaches the mind to lend its sharpest reasoning to a single gleaming bolt of stored aether. Its practitioners unleash shots whose force grows with their own keen wit, so that a sharp scholar's strike outweighs a brute's blow.

rites.name: Ryennaerlae
rites.text: Ryennaerlae is a shimmering aether-tuned marksman who, after ten years of practice, learns to unravel the protective wards of anything they strike. Each successful hit loosens the target's guard further, until a single clean shot can break through the defenses of a fortress-grade ward and blow a hole through the far wall.

rites.name: Elerluanae
rites.text: Elerluanae is a dormant arcane conduit in the Alaenneirae sky-forges, a concept of a single volley of bottled starfire that can be loosed once in a single quick breath. Its keepers say the second release drains the forge for a full day of rest before the wellspring refills.

rites.name: Siliorlae
rites.text: Siliorlae is a concept of tethered guardian-shards that drift beside those they protect and can channel touch-based workings through them across short distances. Each shard can raise a brief shimmering barrier against incoming harm, though the number of such wards a bearer may call upon is limited until a full rest restores them.

rites.name: Ilyilenneth
rites.text: Ilyilenneth is a lattice of force-walls strung between resonant standing stones called Nouliths, raised by an arcane practitioner who binds them into translucent barriers that can cage a creature or split a battlefield. Its walls are sturdy enough to bear a person's weight and can be dismantled in an instant once the caster wills it.

rites.name: Oriemeth
rites.text: Oriemeth is a shard of ward-glass hung in the vaults of Alaenneirae, a conceptual lattice that stores a guardian's resolve. When it shields an ally at the height of its wielder's craft, the protected one is wreathed in a thin silver margin that absorbs blows before they land.

rites.name: Oriileth
rites.text: Oriileth is a wardweaving art practiced in the Veil-Cities of Alaenneirae, where adepts bind protective sigils to a sworn companion's gear. At its height, the adept can flood a bearer's armour with aetheric light, forming a shell that turns away blows below a set strength for a brief time.

rites.name: Lyemileth
rites.text: Lyemileth is a silver-veined resonance lattice that hums when it draws the lingering aether out of a struck foe, storing it as glowing motes that sages in the Arcane realm can forge into fleeting spells. Its stored motes fade within the hour, and the lattice must rest through a full night before it can gather again.

rites.name: Miirleth
rites.text: Miirleth is the silent architecture that lets intention bend the world's hidden currents. It does not grant power but reveals the seams where will can slip into matter.

rites.name: Ryennys
rites.text: Ryennys is an old resonance-technique that lets a weaver split a harmful pulse into two threads, one that strikes and one that shields. The weaver burns a measure of stored breath to knot the shield-thread around chosen allies, letting them step through the danger untouched. Masters say the knack comes from listening to the silence between heartbeats.

rites.name: Alaarwen
rites.text: Alaarwen is a wandering arithmetic that rewrites the weight of chance wherever it passes, turning near misses into clean strikes and clean strikes into near misses. Those who bargain with it learn to feel the world bend around their intent, though the ledger always balances in the end.

rites.name: Elinae
rites.text: Elinae is the living hush of the Alaenneirae deeps, a drifting concept of sustained enchantment that lingers where spells are stretched beyond their natural span. It is said to fold passing hours into itself like thread onto a spindle, keeping charms awake long after their makers have turned to dust.

rites.name: Ryamaelwen
rites.text: Ryamaelwen is a fleeting lattice of resonant glyphs that weaves through the ether of the Arcane realm, allowing its bearer to twist the fate of a single spell's resistance. By channeling three pulses of its core lattice, the wielder can veil a chosen target in a veil of uncertainty, making its first defense roll falter.

rites.name: Mieneth
rites.text: Mieneth is a translocational principle that lets a spell be cast from the perspective of any anchored crystal of its kind, effectively moving the caster's point of influence across great distances. By spending a single crystal charge, the practitioner can treat themselves as if they stood at the crystal's site, reshaping range and line of sight for the incantation. The effect is limited by the crystal's resonance and the caster's own power reserves.

rites.name: Sileranae
rites.text: Sileranae is a sigil-thread woven through the tide-glass lattices of the Alaenneirae deep-sea courts, a quiet notation that lets a caster hasten a working by spending small crystalline charges. Scholars of the third age describe it as a hinge between patience and urgency, rarely invoked outside the coral archives.

rites.name: Nuenualys
rites.text: Nuenualys is a hidden conduit of raw mystic flow that lets a practitioner invoke a rite without the usual gestures or spoken cues. By drawing a single spark of its essence, the effect erupts immediately, channeling pure intent into the world.

rites.name: Miallionae
rites.text: In the realm of Lyrathis, a shimmering mist known as the Echo Veil can be invoked to duplicate a single‑target effect. By channeling a pulse of mist equal to the effect’s potency, the caster may extend the same influence to a second target within line of sight, provided the original effect was not designed for multi‑target application. This ability grants strategic flexibility while preserving the uniqueness of one‑off powers.

rites.name: Ryerae
rites.text: ryerae is a resonant field that amplifies a being’s innate vibrational frequency, allowing it to channel ambient energy into focused pulses. when activated, the field draws from the surrounding ether, converting it into a burst that can be directed at a target or used to recharge the user’s own reserves. the effect scales with the user’s mastery, granting additional charge capacity as proficiency grows.

rites.name: Mieraellys
rites.text: Mieraellys is a concept of forced aetheric siphoning, named for the act of wrenching resonant charges out of the world's living current. Within the realm of Arcane, it is a cultivated art taught in the sixth era, where practitioners who master it can hold many active resonances at once and draw fresh charge from the surrounding ether with a single hurried gesture.

rites.name: Veneirliel
rites.text: Veneirliel is a rage-state, a ferocity that a warrior of the Arcane realm can call up in the middle of battle, letting the instinct beneath their skin move without restraint. Those who ride it grow brutal and bloody-minded, shrugging off wounds while the fury lasts and paying for it with a weary stillness afterward. Its power is the stuff of duels and battlefields rather than of cosmic catastrophe.

rites.name: Veniorae
rites.text: Veniorae is a concept of a fierce, unguarded surge in the arcane realm of Alaenneirae, where a fighter abandons defense to strike with desperate force. It is the reckless tide that sweeps over an opening, trading protection for a brief, blazing offensive edge.

rites.name: Elileth
rites.text: Elileth is a quiet discipline in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, taught in the sixth epoch to those who have grown past their first trials. Its practitioners learn to project a settled presence that unsettles rivals before any blow is struck. The art is measured by a steady inner reckoning that fixes its power to the adept's bodily strength.

rites.name: Lyirlae
rites.text: Lyirlae is a reflexive guardian-technique of the Arcane realm, a stance-art that teaches the body to slip backward a single stride at the instant of a blow and dissipate part of its force. It can be invoked only once before the practitioner must rest deeply to regain the reflex.

rites.name: Lyimwen
rites.text: Lyimwen is an arcane technique in which a practitioner draws upon a stored wellspring of primal fury to press a conversation into submission. The inner beast lends its voice a weight that rattles listeners, turning a plain word into a command of the room. Its power is spent in bursts, so only the bravest or most desperate speakers dare to call upon it.

rites.name: Nuerioniel
rites.text: Nuerioniel is a silver-threaded sorcery of rapid strides, drawn from the tidal lattices of the Alaenneirae sky-reefs. Practitioners who master it can unleash a second strike in the wake of their sprint, each blow carrying the marrow-deep vigor of their own endurance.

rites.name: Venila
rites.text: Venila is a quiet counter-art practiced by the duelist-scholars of the Alaenneirae reaches, who learn to answer a blade's stroke with a stroke of their own at the very instant it lands. Its mastery is said to come only after a practitioner has survived eleven seasons of sparring against spirits that never tire. Those who attain it can turn an opponent's momentum back upon them before the blow completes.

rites.name: Elanneth
rites.text: Elanneth is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a fury-bound art in which a mind that has surrendered to rage can, at the peak of its frenzy, sever itself from the wrath it wears and cast it aside to shrug off a clinging curse. Its practitioners are feared for turning their own ferocity into a shield that snaps shut at the last instant before a spell or poison takes hold.

rites.name: Silamwen
rites.text: Silamwen is a concept of raw kinetic fury in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a force that gathers in a fighter's body until one devastating strike releases it all at once. Those who witness it describe a shockwave that rolls through stone and bone alike, and the wielder is left spent and calm afterward.

rites.name: Miamioleth
rites.text: Miamioleth is a dormant ember-song woven into the marrow of the Arcane realm's oldest ash-choirs, stirring only when a bearer's rage crosses the threshold of the seventeenth veil. Those who wake it find their reflexes doubled in fury, answering two calls of the blade-and-breath in every single heartbeat of the storm.

rites.name: Silerleth
rites.text: Silerleth is a drowned-cathedral warden of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a being that refuses to fall while its tether holds. When the rage of the Vaulted Hollow rises within it, it binds a nearby foe with spectral chains that drag them into a circle it will not leave.

rites.name: Ryanna
rites.text: Ryanna is a drifting concept of woven storm-glass, born in the fourth age of Alaenneirae as a discipline of recovered fury. Those who master her may draw back spent wrath the moment a battle begins, turning exhaustion into a second wind that roars through the opening clash.

rites.name: Silanniel
rites.text: Silanniel is a veil-weaving concept of the Arcane realm, a shimmering discipline that bends the intentions of onlookers toward a chosen guardian. Practitioners of the Eighth Loom in the sixth era learn to unravel the aim of a blade or spell that threatens an ally within arm's reach, scattering its focus at the moment of release.

rites.name: Miemys
rites.text: Miemys is a storm-bound oath-art of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, wherein a warrior's frenzy is channeled into a single blow that drains the foe's strength for a brief span. Its practitioners are said to carry the weather of their sworn ground inside their ribs, releasing it only once per fury.

rites.name: Ryirennys
rites.text: Ryirennys is a dormant beast-song concept from the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, an old technique that lets a wielder briefly quiet and command wild creatures through a single borrowed heartbeat. Its tradition holds that the bond can be woken only once before the wielder must rest and let the wild settle again.

rites.name: Orieruamwen
rites.text: Orieruamwen is an arcane concept in Alaenneirae, a rite of the ninth age where a warrior lets a buried wild spirit surface for a single strike. The blow lands with the force of a falling tide, and the striker drinks back a rush of vitality before the spirit retreats into the marrow.

rites.name: Alaina
rites.text: Alaina is a sword-dance of the Arcane realm's sixth era, a discipline of fury-channelled blades that grows sharper as the practitioner ages. Early in her training, a frenzy opens hairline seams in any foe's guard, and later the seams widen until nearly every stroke finds them.

rites.name: Silualora
rites.text: Silualora is a rune-sealed greatsword forged in the sky-foundries of Alaenneirae, said to hold a captured sliver of a dying gale. When its wielder falls into battle-fury, a single well-placed blow can rip that gale loose, binding the struck foe in a whirlwind of battering pressure for several heartbeats.

rites.name: Eleraerla
rites.text: Eleraerla is a feral resonance that awakens within Alaenneirae's arcane wilds at a certain threshold of mastery, letting a wielder's dormant instinct take over their body and sharpen one chosen discipline of movement or survival. Those who bind it speak of the beast as a patient partner that doubles their skill whenever the moment calls for precision. Its influence is a quiet thing, never a violent eruption.

rites.name: Nuemwen
rites.text: Nuemwen is a sealed dormant hunger of the Arcane realm, awakened in the Alaenneirae era to lend its stolen strength to a bearer who chooses one discipline of motion or endurance. The bearer's body answers the hunger with sharpened reflexes, and where skill was already present, the hunger doubles it.

rites.name: Elamerlys
rites.text: Elamerlys is a quiet power of the Arcane realm that wakes a hidden feral will within a bearer's body, sharpening one chosen discipline of motion, pursuit, or wilderness craft. Those who master it move as though the land itself yields to them, slipping through thorns and leaping ravines with unnerving ease. Its weight in the omniverse is measured more in refinement than in ruin.

rites.name: Eliorleth
rites.text: Eliorleth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the E6 era, a hidden predator-spirit that wakes within a chosen mortal and sharpens one of four instincts: swiftness, strength, shadow-stepping, or wilderness sense. Its power is quiet and personal, rarely reaching beyond the body of its host.

rites.name: Oriirlionys
rites.text: Oriirlionys is a dormant beast-spirit that wakes within the bloodline of Alaenneirae's wild-hearted hunters, lending them tempered strength and swift grace. Its power surges when a chosen discipline of body is tested, sharpening reflexes or endurance to a keen edge.

rites.name: Silerla
rites.text: Silerla is a concept-class arcane discipline from the E6 age of Alaenneirae, a ritual of focused frenzy in which a practitioner channels pent-up fury into a single, decisive strike. Its adepts describe it as a storm gathered into one blade's edge, released only once and then spent entirely.

rites.name: Lyinwen
rites.text: Lyinwen is a tenth-era arcane discipline of the Alaenneirae omniverse, a rage-song that lets a warrior drink strength back from each blow struck in battle. Its practitioners regrow wounds from the rhythm of their own strikes, and the older masters can knit a fresh gash closed with a single well-timed cut.

rites.name: Sileimaenys
rites.text: Sileimaenys is a rite of the Veiled Choir, a silent discipline in which a warrior sheds all guard and lets grief become momentum. Its practitioners are said to hurl themselves into fury once per ritual, bleeding raw ambition into every blow while refusing the shelter of defense. The art is rare, prized in the ash-fields of Oumbrath where survival is seldom granted to those who fight without fear.

rites.name: Eleina
rites.text: Eleina is a silver-threaded concept of social perception within the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a quiet art of reading the pride and fear in others. Those who master it learn, after a single minute of conversation, which bluster will bend a listener and which will break them.

rites.name: Venuaniel
rites.text: Venuaniel is a concept of arcane resonance in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a discipline in which a practitioner's fury is shaped into a single devastating pulse of sound and force. The art is said to be drawn from the rage of an ancient wind-spirit that was sealed into a bell of black iron.

rites.name: Mienneth
rites.text: Mienneth is a devotional rite-sense of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, where each silent appeal to the unseen builds a gathering of sworn resolve. Its bearers accumulate Vows that swell when doubled and fade the moment the tension of battle leaves them. Their strongest act calls the built-up resolve into a single disciplined strike.

rites.name: Sileinniel
rites.text: Sileinniel is a quiet covenant of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a bond between a caster and the wandering elemental spirits that drift through the reed-marshes of the Vael basin. Each spoken confession grants a single ember of trust that a caster may pour into the spirits, who then carry touch-magic outward across open air. The practice is young, only three ages old, and its elders still argue over how far such messengers can be trusted.

rites.name: Nuarirliel
rites.text: Nuarirliel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a silver lattice of listening mirrors that hums whenever a penitent speaks truly. Those who keep its vigil can spend stored confessions as balm, mending the wounded nearby in proportion to the truths they have given up. Its sacred rhythm is said to hold steady only while the lattice remains unbroken and undisturbed.

rites.name: Alainna
rites.text: Alainna is a concept-kind entry from the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, dwelling in the powers locale of the sixth era. Its nature is a last-breath surge: when its strength gives out and it collapses, it releases a single wave of restorative light that mends its companions within a short radius, after which it must rest deeply before doing so again.

rites.name: Silaenniel
rites.text: Silaenniel is a sealed vow-engine of the Arcane realm, kindled in the fourth age of Alaenneirae to hold the oaths of dying oathkeepers. It wakes each time a battle begins, storing two charges of spoken truth that can be loosed as a single burst of binding light.

rites.name: Venarla
rites.text: Venarla is a crystalline lattice that hums with latent resonance, capable of infusing any nearby melee implement with a pulse of harmonic distortion. When activated, the lattice emits a focused burst that temporarily alters the kinetic properties of a target weapon, rendering it capable of delivering a single strike that shatters the very fabric of the struck surface. The lattice’s resonance can be tuned by the wielder’s intent, allowing for a spectrum of effects from mild vibration to catastrophic rupture.

rites.name: Ryalerwen
rites.text: Ryalerwen is a sixth-age attunement in Alaenneirae, a quiet craft by which a seer listens to the rooted and wandering spirits of the land for a single long hour of stillness. What the spirits share becomes a silver sketch of the surrounding country, with the forgotten paths and hollows drawn as clearly as the roads. The gift returns only after a full night of rest, and it lets the seer pierce the thickest gloom as though it were dusk.

rites.name: Silinwen
rites.text: Silinwen is a concept of a shared vow of protection kept by mortal wardens who bind their own confessions into a steady flame. Each warden may lend a ward against one chosen elemental force for a short span of time, the duration set by their own steadiness of mind. The vow is spent in quiet acts of guardianship rather than open battle.

rites.name: Sileirlae
rites.text: Sileirlae is a gilded litany-engine kept by the hollow monks of Vennoth Spire, who whisper its names to coax elemental debts from the storms beneath the world. Each spoken charge binds a shard of the elementals' patience, and once enough are paid the engine can lend the caster a spell far beyond their own training. Its use leaves the speaker's voice thinner with every borrowed working.

rites.name: Nuena
rites.text: Nuena is a concept of restorative resonance woven through the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, where mending light gathers in the bones of a healer and spills outward to strengthen whoever is touched. In the third age of the sixth era it is studied as a discipline in its own right, with scholars measuring how each mending carries a little extra vitality beyond what was spent.

rites.name: Oriinnae
rites.text: Oriinnae is a sustained gift of the healing arts, granted to those who have learned to read the rhythm of living bodies. Its bearers sense the faltering pulse of a failing soul and draw it back toward stillness, and they can name a sickness from the faintest murmur of its symptoms.

rites.name: Miellae
rites.text: Miellae is a concept of restorative grace in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a sigil that a healer may turn inward on a wound and outward on a foe. Its power is measured in the small dramatic weight of a single radiant pulse, bounded by the mortal caster's will. It is said that the sigil cannot mend what it has not first been willing to hurt.

rites.name: Elaemiorae
rites.text: In the realm of Arcaneus, the concept of Elaemiorae emerges, harnessing the power of truth to amplify healing. Born in the era of E6, it resides in the powers of Alaenneirae, withstanding up to 1e32 J of energy.

rites.name: Silinwen
rites.text: Silinwen is a sealed chorus-engine of the Alaenneirae, a bell of pale glass that stores the spoken regrets of its keepers as luminous charge. When a keeper releases those stored admissions outward, they strike as bright, scalding light across open air.

rites.name: Oriirys
rites.text: Oriirys is a silver-stitched veil of attunement that its wielder draws over the ruined district of Vael'morrow, letting her hear the pulse of hollow things and bound shades that wander the broken streets. Its power sleeps after each use and returns only when the sleeper has rested fully through the night.

rites.name: Siliorlina
rites.text: Siliorlina is a warding sigil-tattoo worn by hospice wardens of the Alaenneirae, a ritual that stores a dying person's last breath as a glowing ember beneath the skin. While the ember burns, the bearer casts a pale nimbus that numbs decay and hastens mending for everyone standing within its reach.

rites.name: Venirlys
rites.text: Venirlys is a sealed-ink confessional rite that the Alaenneirae chroniclers filed during the third age of the E6 arcane cycle, when hidden vows were still spoken aloud at dusk. Its practitioners bind a single spoken secret into a spell, and the bound words make the working cut deeper against the restless dead and the infernal. Its strength is local rather than cosmic, shaped entirely by the weight of what was confessed.

rites.name: Alailiomae
rites.text: Alailiomae is a silver-threaded lattice of listening sigils woven through the Alaenneirae hearth-tapestries, letting its bearer sense the faint pulse of hidden things. Its carriers say the lattice tightens when someone lies within a hundred paces, and it has been known to flare hard enough to shatter nearby glass.

rites.name: Alaenae
rites.text: Alaenae is a quiet ward-sigil of the Alaenneirae concordance, a thin silver lattice that settles over a body when it carries no metal or hide and lets its nimbleness become a shield of its own. The sigil is taught in the Arcane schools of the fourth age as a gentle discipline rather than a weapon, and it is said to bloom brightest in dancers and river-scouts.

rites.name: Nuiniel
rites.text: Nuiniel is an arcane concept of the fourth age, a ritual of resonance in which a vow is bound into the marrow of the caster and released as a single pulse. Its practitioners measure their worth by how much of their own strength they can hold back before it breaks free. Those who master it can shatter a stone wall or quiet a storm for a heartbeat.

rites.name: Sileila
rites.text: Sileila is a dormant arcane principle that the scholars of Alaenneirae describe as a lattice of quiet resonances, woven into the old stars during the sixth era. Its sanctioned uses are few, and its most reliable manifestation is a gentle attunement that lets an adept read the rhythms of wild places.

rites.name: Elaenemae
rites.text: Elaenemae is a sustained arcane resonance that tempers a warrior's strike when it lands true, folding an echo of the blow's own force back into the wound. In the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae it stands as a concept of the sixth era's fourth age, a quiet refinement rather than a titan.

rites.name: Elimionora
rites.text: Elimionora is a silver-threaded binding of pact-craft that the Alaenneirae scholars of the fourth age taught to speak directly to the wills of spirits and sovereigns. Its practitioners learn to make a hearing mind agree to a shared aim without force. It is prized for diplomacy yet feared for how quietly it can bend a court.

rites.name: Silioleima
rites.text: Silioleima is a veil of woven resonance that the Alaenneirae scholars of the fourth age learned to cast over the mind, turning aside lures of enchantment as a river turns a stone. Its wearers hear the false song of charm and step quietly past it, though the sheltering weave thins where the sky's own music is loudest.

rites.name: Alaemualeth
rites.text: Alaemualeth is a resonant attunement in the arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a sensing discipline that lets a listener feel the hum of distant leylines through the bones of the ear. In the sixth era, scholars of the Veil taught it as a way to hear sorcery being woven across the sky.

rites.name: Orierlys
rites.text: Orierlys is a silent discipline of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, practiced by wanderers who bind starlight into thin threads of will during the fourth age of the sixth epoch. Its adepts can briefly hold a fragment of a dying sun's fury within a single crystal lens, though the practice demands long and patient restraint.

rites.name: Elemineth
rites.text: Elemineth is a quiet, sharpening art taught in the glass monasteries of Alaenneirae, where practitioners learn to read the slightest tremor in a rival's stance and the faintest shift in the wind. Its adepts are prized as scouts and tutors of cunning rather than as warriors, though their aim is said to bend with their discipline.

rites.name: Venilaemwen
