rites.text: Venilaemwen is a quiet arcane principle of the Alaenneirae omniverse, a thread of stillness that lengthens the reach of projectiles drawn through its channels. Four ages after its first recorded use, scholars still debate whether it bends distance or merely persuades the air to forgive it.

rites.name: Elameinys
rites.text: Elameinys is a quiet discipline of listening to the hidden hum beneath spoken words, practiced by the scholars of Alaenneirae's Arcane era. Adepts can sense the resonance of a lie long before it is finished being told.

rites.name: Elaniel
rites.text: Elaniel is a veil-weave of quiet shadow that thickens in caverns and unlit hollows, letting its bearer slip between the eyes of watchers as though she were a rumour of dusk. Her arts were taught to the lamp-wardens of the sunken archives of Vesh Oraun, who still whisper her name when they snuff their last flame.

rites.name: Nuileneth
rites.text: Nuileneth is the sealed grammar of a binding-art in Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, a sigil-language that lets a practitioner hold the memory of a skill in their own marrow. Its practitioners are said to inherit the weapon-craft of anyone whose name they whisper while the moon is young.

rites.name: Sileinora
rites.text: Sileinora is a veil of cold starlight woven into the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during its sixth era, a concept that hums through the shared powers of its people. It stirs the quiet understanding of sacred things, letting those who touch it read the hidden rites that bind their world together.

rites.name: Venaemeth
rites.text: Venaemeth is a concept of arcane dependence: a people whose inner wells of power are too thin to shape the Weave unaided, and who therefore rely on resonant lattices of crystal and brass to draw and hold their magic. Its practitioners carry lattice-rods that slowly gather ambient mana, and their daily spellcraft is measured by how full those rods are when the sun sets. Venaemeth's age is three, and its sorcery remains a borrowed rather than born art.

rites.name: Veniomae
rites.text: Veniomae is a resonant mark-craft of the Alaenneirae arcane orders, a tuning that lets a practitioner settle into one discipline and the tools that serve it. Its adepts speak of the sigil as a second hand that never forgets how a thing was made.

rites.name: Silaleth
rites.text: Silaleth is a quiet arcane principle in the Alaenneirae cosmos, a thread of sharpened attention that lets a seeker read the hidden shape behind appearances. Scholars of the fourth age treat it less as a weapon than as a lens, one that sees through illusions and binding seals alike.

rites.name: Ryinnae
rites.text: Ryinnae is a silver-threaded lattice of starlight that the Arcane scholars of Alaenneirae consider a living concept rather than a substance. Its practitioners sharpen their senses and their aim until distance itself seems to bend toward their eyes and arrows. Its age of four centuries has made it a quiet, widely taught discipline.

rites.name: Elima
rites.text: Elima is a quiet arcane principle in the era of Alaenneirae's fourth age, where scholars hold that a bearer's reach is measured in shifting weight rather than in strength. Its practitioners bend the lattice of mass so that loads seem to answer to a larger body, letting a single traveler haul what a cart team could barely move. The art is mostly taught as a discipline of posture and breath, though its deeper workings remain disputed among the mages of the high halls.

rites.name: Alaenwen
rites.text: Alaenwen is a concept of sharpened resolve within the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, appearing in its fourth age of the sixth era. Its arcane edge is said to cut through any barrier, though its reach remains a local matter of unarmed contact and personal will.

rites.name: Elenniel
rites.text: Elenniel is an arcane sensitive who reads the faint residues of spellwork by the way they linger in the air, a gift that has made her the chief inquisitor of the Ashveil Conclave. In her fourth year of service she unravelled a sealed ward that had kept a dormant starfire sleeping under the Sunken Vaults.

rites.name: Silanae
rites.text: Silanae is a veil of woven starlight-silk that its wearers call a second skin, shimmering in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae during its sixth era. Four centuries old, it is said to bend the reflections of anyone who wears it into the shapes of their own forgotten dreams.

rites.name: Ilyareth
rites.text: Ilyareth is a silver-thread binding of resolve, woven into the mind of anyone who swears an oath before the Veil of Thrane. Its bearers find their hearts steadied against dread, and in its strongest hour it can hold a fleeing legion in place with nothing but a single unbroken note.

rites.name: Alaeranniel
rites.text: Alaeranniel is a rune of pursuit that the Alaenneirae hymnists etched into the boots of their hunters during the fourth age. Its bearers stride toward any foe they can perceive by sight or sound, always gaining ground with every step taken.

rites.name: Nuinys
rites.text: Nuinys is a dormant concept in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a harmonic principle that bends the listener's will like a tuned chord. In the fourth age of the sixth era, scholars believe it once shaped the pacts that held the shifting realms together.

rites.name: Venaeriel
rites.text: Venaeriel is a dream-woven ward, a concept of unshakable mental clarity that the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae has carved into its oldest archives. Four ages old, it steadies minds against enchantment and bends the thoughts of those who would seize control of others.

rites.name: Veneimae
rites.text: Veneimae is a faded resonance-thread woven through the Alaenneirae's arcane lattice, said to be the echo of an old tuning-chant that once steadied the realm's weather. Scholars of the E6 courts describe it as a quiet hum that answers to anyone who learns its cadence, though it has never been seen in full.

rites.name: Alaarlys
rites.text: Alaarlys is a binding-pattern in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a sigil that teaches its bearer the crafts it was woven around. It flares when a student resolves to master a discipline, sharpening memory and muscle into a single keen edge. Scholars of the E6 era regard it as a modest but reliable gift.

rites.name: Eleileth
rites.text: Eleileth is a quiet scriptfont woven into the stacks of the Alaenneirae archive, a concept that teaches apprentices how to hold more than one craft in their hands at once. Its lessons are ordinary in form but reshape the practitioner's sense of what their tools can do.

rites.name: Mianneriel
rites.text: Mianneriel is a binding-glyph of the Alaenneirae arcane tradition, inscribed as a silver thread that tightens the bearer's sinew and tempo. Scholars of the fourth age record it as a rite of endurance that quickens the will to move. Its sustained use leaves a faint luminous trace along the forearms.

rites.name: Oriellae
rites.text: Oriellae is a binding of living root-song that teaches a wielder to hear the quiet grammar of forests, rivers and weather. Its practitioners can coax seasons to shift and mountain springs to rise, though the old choirs warn that every borrowed verse must be paid back in stillness. Scholars of the Arcane realm regard it as the gentlest and most dangerous of the era's sciences.

rites.name: Ilyannae
rites.text: Ilyannae is a mental discipline taught in the cloud-cities of Alaenneirae, where students learn to hold their own thoughts steady against the drift of enchanted currents. Its practitioners are said to resist the sorcerer's hand, bending the spells that would otherwise cloud their minds.

rites.name: Oriinalla
rites.text: Oriinalla is a silent veil-weaving concept in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, believed to let a practitioner slip through the lattice of any being that towers over them. Its scholars describe it as a rite of humility, for the thread only opens where the other's weight is greater than one's own.

rites.name: Venuarae
rites.text: Venuarae is a veil of quiet shadow that clings to anyone standing in the lee of something larger than themselves, letting the smaller hide in the shelter of a giant's silhouette. Scholars of Alaenneirae describe it as a technique of patience rather than force, and it has never been recorded as releasing anything more than a whisper of concealing light.

rites.name: Lyeruanna
rites.text: Lyeruanna is a concept of a faint, shimmering membrane that a sun-scoured people of Alaenneirae grew over their eyes, a living veil that keeps gleaming sand and blinding storms from stealing their sight. Its keepers can lean on that veil to shrug off efforts that would dim their vision. The concept is quiet and modest, a tool of endurance rather than destruction.

rites.name: Alaireth
rites.text: Alaireth is a thread of binding sorcery woven across the Alaenneirae sky, a discipline that lets a caster slip falsehoods into the minds of listeners and bend perceived truth. Its practitioners hold that a well-told lie can reshape a kingdom faster than any blade. The art is young and treated with suspicion by the older orders.

rites.name: Ryirys
rites.text: Ryirys is a dormant ward-sigil woven into the bloodline of the Vellhorn houses, said to bend venom and contagion away from its bearer. In the fourth age of Alaenneirae it is less a weapon than a quiet inheritance, its strength measured by how many generations it has protected. Scholars debate whether it shields the body or merely reshapes what the body believes it can survive.

rites.name: Silaela
rites.text: Silaela is a dormant lattice of glowing sandstone-glass that lines the ruined vaults of Alaenneirae's northern sea-cliffs. Scholars who attune to its ridges can read the hidden pattern of cutting and fitting that built each ancient wall. Its resonance grows sharper with every stone it is brought near.

rites.name: Elaenuamys
rites.text: Elaenuamys is a quiet tide of woven starlight that the scholars of Alaenneirae use to read the hidden currents of thought and intent between living minds. Its practitioners sharpen their senses until a whispered lie or a hidden blade becomes as plain as a shadow at noon. Within the arcane realm, it is valued less for force than for the foresight it grants.

rites.name: Silerora
rites.text: Silerora is a dormant arcane concept in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a latent habit of the ether that slowly stores motion until it is spent. Scholars of the sixth era regard it as a quiet engine of the old weave, not a force meant for open display.

rites.name: Ilyerlae
rites.text: Ilyerlae is the Last Ember of Alaenneirae's dying stars, a flicker of stored sunfire that refuses to go out when a body is pushed past its breaking point. Once per cycle of rest it lets a fallen soul stand again with a single heartbeat of life. Its power is exhausted until the wielder has slept soundly through a full turn of the sky.

rites.name: Ryaneth
rites.text: Ryaneth is a dormant lattice of cold starlight woven into the marrow of Alaenneirae's oldest library-spires, teaching its reader the grammar by which ink becomes weather. Scholars who awaken its last sealed chapter report that it recalls the shaping of the first dawn.

rites.name: Mialenora
rites.text: Mialenora is a concept of a kindled ember-sense within the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, an ancient heat-bearing art that has settled into the local powers of the E6 era. Its adepts draw sparks from their own will, growing from a single flicker to an armored flame that can unmake shaped metal. Its reach stays modest, bounded by the temperament of whoever carries it.

rites.name: Veninys
rites.text: Veninys is a veil-weaving art of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae, letting its practitioners blend into the drifting veils of weather and wild growth. Its adherents claim the ability to vanish whenever mist, rain, or leaves offer even the faintest cover.

rites.name: Miala
rites.text: Miala is a hushed art of hearth-song and open-palm signing, by which a practitioner passes plain notions to any creature no larger than a hound. Its gestures are said to carry a faint ringing of sorrow and mirth that the smallest wild things answer without fear.

rites.name: Silaemys
rites.text: Silaemys is a sealed grammar of sorrow-bound glyphs drawn across the rotting hulls of the Alaenneirae drift-fleets, each mark said to remember the last breath of its author. Scholars of the Arcane realm warn that reading it aloud can wake the echo of a dead empire's war-hymn.

rites.name: Elaelora
rites.text: Elaelora is a sealed resonance of the Arcane realm, born four ages ago when the first chords of a forgotten song bent the local laws of matter into obedient harmony. She is less a being than a standing invitation: whoever learns her cadence can coax even the stubborn ledgers of the world into agreement.

rites.name: Miamioneth
rites.text: Miamioneth is a radiant pulse of arcane vitality that the Alaenneirae mages of the sixth era draw from their own bodies, mending allies while scorching foes who fail to resist it. Its strength grows with the reserves a caster is willing to spend, so the sixth-era schools teach that restraint matters as much as power.

rites.name: Veniometh
rites.text: Veniometh is a concept of sanctified light in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, an invented ward that gathers into a hovering sphere of mending radiance. Those standing inside it are slowly knit back together and shielded against blades, blunt force, and the rot of death magic. Its strength grows with every additional measure of power poured into its making.

rites.name: Venuarliel
rites.text: Venuarliel is a silver-white sigil-flare that gathers the dawn-light of Alaenneirae's Arcane realm into a single searing point. Those who fail to dodge it are scorched through their defenses, while the lucky are only grazed by its burning edge.

rites.name: Miima
rites.text: Miima is a concept of starlit sorcery, an astral discharge that wraps its caster in a dim sphere of drifting constellations. Anyone caught within the luminous shell is struck dumb by the heavens above and staggered by the blow. Its power is tuned to the sky-binding arts of the Arcane realm's third age.

rites.name: Sileina
rites.text: Sileina is a concept of protective sanctuary in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a shimmering dome of woven ward-light that knits wounds and steadies the stance of anyone sheltered within it. It is a crafted discipline of the third age, taught in the sixth epoch by lay-mages who valued mending over destruction.

rites.name: Alaarinna
rites.text: Alaarinna is a dread-glass lantern of the Ashen Choir, a crystal sphere that drinks warmth and gutters into a hungering violet core when its bearer wills it. Choirs of the Evenmoot carry it as both a weapon and a burial rite, releasing its stored hunger to unmake the living.

rites.name: Silenwen
rites.text: Silenwen is an arcane concept of the Alaenneirae omniverse, a tide of withering force a practitioner draws from their own limb and flings outward in a fan. Its bearers are rare, prized for striking many foes at once while leaving their own bodies unbowed. In the third age of the sixth era it is taught only in hidden conclaves.

rites.name: Miilla
rites.text: Miilla is a concept in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, an old practice in which the marrow of buried silence is drawn up through the soil beneath a chosen target. Its tremor is felt by everything standing within a wide ring around the point, and those who brace against it are only partly spared. Practitioners of the E6 era spoke of it as a quiet ruin that remembers.

rites.name: Lyeniolae
rites.text: Lyeniolae is a blighted ring of rot-stained soil that a caster raises from the ground in a single act, its dead loam clinging to every boot that crosses it. Those who walk its stretch feel the grave's chill seep into their marrow, and the sudden eruption of decayed earth strikes everything within its border.

rites.name: Venaera
rites.text: Venaera is a silver-veined mist of drifting spores that hangs above the Ossuary Fens of Alaenneirae, where it siphons vitality from anything caught in its reach. Its tendrils can rip the warmth from a creature's marrow and feed it back into the weaver of the cloud. The mist is said to have once swallowed a moon's worth of living tide in a single exhale.

rites.name: Siluarlae
rites.text: Siluarlae is a sealed ember-glyph, a concept of sudden inward collapse that the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae keeps as a lesson in restraint. Its bearer marks a chosen point upon a living frame, and that mark bursts outward as a hot sphere of ash-light, scorching and crushing everything within its bounds. Those caught may flinch aside for lesser harm.

rites.name: Silemiriel
rites.text: Silemiriel is a conceptual arcane art in the realm of Alaenneirae, where a caster draws starfire through a focus to birth a brief, dense ember of stellar matter in a chosen place. Its gravity gathers and rattles everything nearby while a low, pulsing hum fills the air. The ember collapses into nothing once its borrowed time runs out.

rites.name: Silareth
rites.text: Silareth is a radiant sphere-shaping art of the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, practiced by sky-wardens of the third age who seal their light into hovering orbs. When its gathered glow is released, the orb blooms into a searing detonation that staggers all within its reach.

rites.name: Venuamora
rites.text: Venuamora is a crystalline lattice of condensed aether that drifts through the Arcane tiers of Alaenneirae, humming faintly when it senses a living mind. Its shards can be lured from the lattice by a practiced hand and hurled at foes, and the lattice regrows them within the hour. Three ages past, the Sisters of Thrane learned to fracture it in sympathy, scattering its power across many targets at once.

rites.name: Orienys
rites.text: Orienys is a restorative cantrip-like working of the Arcane realm, practiced by wardens of the third age of Alaenneirae to mend wounded travellers with a gentle tide of warmth. It can be called in an instant of need, as a flinch-response to another's injury, and grows stronger when channelled through higher reserves of the caster's will.

rites.name: Siliorleth
rites.text: Siliorleth is a silver-threaded blessing of the Alaenneirae arcane tradition, woven into the flesh of a chosen bearer so that torn sinew and broken bone knit themselves back a little at every turn. Its mending grows stronger the deeper the caster's reserve, drawing on higher-tier mana to add further restorative dice to each pulse.

rites.name: Eleimiola
rites.text: Eleimiola is a warding art of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a sphere of binding lattice that a caster raises over a chosen spot so that allies within it bear less harm. Each blow that lands on a sheltered ally is softened by a small, rolled measure of absorption, and the ward deepens when woven with higher-tier reserves. It is a discipline valued for protection rather than destruction.

rites.name: Sileirlora
rites.text: Sileirlora is a concept-era arcane channeling rite of the Alaenneirae omniverse, in which the practitioner draws a fierce seam of stored pressure from the deep grain of the world to burst a column of frigid water upward. The rite wraps its wielder in a veil that holds only while they remain still, unwilling to strike or work spells.

rites.name: Lyanniel
rites.text: Lyanniel is a living spring-spirit of Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, who mends wounded travelers with pulses of silver mist drawn from the tides of its own heart. Its restorative touch grows stronger the deeper the spirit draws upon the ancient reservoirs bound within its body.

rites.name: Lyaleth
rites.text: Lyaleth is an arcane discipline in Alaenneirae, a fourth-age concept that teaches a practitioner to strike faster than thought by adding a final blow to a fast flurry of strikes whenever the first two land true. Its masters measure power by how precisely that last blow is weighted, and its scriptures describe a perfect strike as one that lands as the echo of the previous two.

rites.name: Ilyanneth
rites.text: Ilyanneth is a monastic meditation discipline in Alaenneirae that lets a practitioner attune to fire, earth, or wind after rest. Each attunement reshapes the body into a living weapon or shield, drawing on the adept's inner calm. Its scope stays within a single battlefield, not the scale of worlds.

rites.name: Venioluamys
rites.text: Venioluamys is a radiant pulse that transforms the bearer’s inner energy into a spectrum of elemental blasts, each tailored to the current state of their spirit. When the soul is aflame, a blazing fist erupts; when it is grounded, a protective mist engulfs allies; and when it is swift, a spiraling strike rains upon foes. Each manifestation can be amplified by channeling extra vitality, adding further power to the release.

rites.name: Silualae
rites.text: Silualae is a concept of perfect poise in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a stillness that lets a practitioner briefly fold their inner reserves into a single strike. Its power is limited to moments of perfect balance and must be renewed by rest after each use.

rites.name: Eleniel
rites.text: Eleniel is a concept of Arcane power in Alaenneirae, a warrior-mystic who channels inner flame through bare fists. Her strikes can be kindled into searing fire, and a single breath of focused will lets her unleash many blows across a fan of foes at once.

rites.name: Silaemwen
rites.text: Silaemwen is a concept of lattice-binding discipline within the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, a practice where a wielder's steadfast composure blunts the blows of mundane weapons. Adepts within the Third Age may redirect half the harm befalling a nearby ally onto themselves by spending a reserve of inner vitality in a single reflexive instant.

rites.name: Orielys
rites.text: Orielys is a concept-level arcane discipline in Alaenneirae's E6 era, three years old, that lets a practitioner turn their fists into conduits of lightning and move with quickened stride. Its adepts can briefly leap higher or stride farther, and with greater effort lift themselves into the air. The discipline is young but already spreading among the wind-cloisters of the highlands.

rites.name: Elaerenae
rites.text: Elaerenae is a discipline of Arcane arts, practiced in the Alaenneirae omniverse during the third age of the sixth era. Its adepts channel vital force through the body's inner centers, letting it erupt from the earth as a roaring column that batters everything within its path.

rites.name: Ryenualeth
rites.text: Ryenualeth is a concept of latent arcane power in the Alaenneirae era of the sixth epoch, a force that sheds aether like a silver rain when its bearer opens the inner wells of the body. Its bursts can scour a tight ring of ground, and its rarest forms, drawn from a forbidden seat of the spirit, grow more violent with each extra measure of will given to them.

rites.name: Mialeinnys
rites.text: Mialeinnys is a concept of disciplined inner force in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, drawn from the old practice of channeling vital currents through the body's seven hidden wells. It is said to let a practitioner leap skyward and rain blows upon a single foe, each strike carrying a surge far beyond natural strength.

rites.name: Miennuarys
rites.text: Miennuarys is a sealed grammar of old vows, carved into the bones of a drowned archive in Alaenneirae's third age. Those who speak its clauses in the right order are granted small, precise miracles that grow with the speaker's standing.

rites.name: Sileirwen
rites.text: Sileirwen is a concept-born oathkeeper of Alaenneirae's Arcane realm, a warden whose bond draws the harm of a nearby ally into her own body. Her presence alone compels hostile wills to turn their blades toward her, shielding the frailer souls around her.

rites.name: Miinae
rites.text: Miinae is a binding of shared suffering woven by the aetherial weavers of Alaenneirae, who bind a willing companion's wounds to their own flesh. The bond holds only as long as the two stand close, and it may be cut at will by the one who carries the pain.

rites.name: Elaenys
rites.text: Elaenys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Alaenneirae omniverse, a presence that bends the attention of nearby foes toward itself. Its authority radiates outward in a thirty-foot sphere, compelling hostile minds to fixate on it as the one true threat. The fixation lasts only as long as the entity's commanding charm allows.

rites.name: Eleiremeth
rites.text: Eleiremeth is a veil of woven starlight that an ascendant warden draws across the ones they guard, taking half of every blow aimed at an ally upon their own shoulders. In the later mastery of the art the veil widens to a far larger circle, so that no companion standing near the warden can be struck without the warden's shining aura absorbing the wound.

rites.name: Mienillys
rites.text: Mienillys is a ward-tongue of the Alaenneirae arcane orders, a discipline in which a warden binds a sealed fragment of their own vow into a reflex that turns aside incoming strikes. It was taught only in the third age's quiet archives, where practitioners spend a measure of restored vigor to bend an assault away from their ally.

rites.name: Mienniel
rites.text: Mienniel is a veiled disciple of the Alaenneirae arcane orders, known for raising wardings of pure intent that sheer away all harm for a short span before the caster's reserves must rest. Those who study her wards say her barriers hold against almost anything the mind can imagine, yet they fade the moment she has spent herself.

rites.name: Lyameiniel
rites.text: Lyameiniel is a Hand-Sealer of the Alaenneirae Arcane realm, a disciplined practitioner who threads mudra into layered ninjutsu that bend elemental forces to their will. Within the third era of the realm, this arcane tradition has grown from a single fleeting gesture into a discipline capable of shaping vast geography and stellar-scale disturbances.

rites.name: Miileth
rites.text: Miileth is a concept of silent displacement in the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, an art that lets a practitioner step through gaps and vanish in a single instant. Its later refinement leaves a dense drifting veil of smoke that lingers for a short while after the vanishing.

rites.name: Orialys
rites.text: Orialys is a silent discipline of the Arcane realm, a weaving of breath and gesture that a practitioner learns only after mastering the lesser arts of stillness. When a hidden strike lands, the practitioner may spend the sealed gestures stored in the body to mark the foe with a fleeting flaw, so that every blow aimed at it finds its mark for a single heartbeat of battle.

rites.name: Nuiniel
rites.text: Nuiniel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae, a stillness that sharpens into a second breath of sorcery whenever a first working has been loosed. Once per cycle of rest, it can fold the weave of a spell upon itself so that it fires at the pace of thought, and only a full recovery of the hours restores that folding.

rites.name: Eluarora
rites.text: Eluarora is a resonant chorus-concept woven into the song-threads of Alaenneirae, a shield-hymn that wraps a companion in a shimmering aura of borrowed vitality. Its sung protection flares when blades or spells strike, then steadies the sheltered mind against deceptions and psychic assault.

rites.name: Ilyinae
rites.text: Ilyinae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaenneirae's sixth era, a grief-song that teaches the hearer the weight of fallen wars and sorrowful ends. Its verses tighten the hand of any listener who hears them, drawing back strikes that would otherwise fall with full force.

rites.name: Lyana
rites.text: Lyana is a concept from the Arcane realm of Alaenneirae, an era-six artifact of song-craft in which a melody woven around a spell lends its wavering confidence to nearby allies. Her voice steadies hands that would otherwise falter, so that a blow is more likely to find the weak point of a foe for a span measured by the caster's presence. She is a catalyst rather than a weapon, and her reach is bounded by how far her words can carry.
